44To reduce risk of long-context extension, we have excluded PKO and use NoPE on
45long layers.
46- **XSA (Exclusive Self-Attention)**: after attention, subtract the component
47  of each head's output parallel to its `aligned_v`: `z = y − (yᵀv / ‖v‖²)·v`
48  per head. Followed by a headwise sigmoid gate.
49 
50**Norms.**
51- **GatedNorm**: rank-128 low-rank gate on RMS-normalised input pre-attention
52  and pre-MLP. Acts as a learned per-token gate over the hidden dimension.
53 
54**Optimizer + schedule** ([`heuristic.py`](./heuristic.py) +
55[`optimizer.py`](./optimizer.py)).
56- **MuonH** (`GrugMoeMuonHConfig`, registered as `grug_moe_muonh_v1`):
57  Newton-Schulz orthogonalisation + Frobenius-hyperball scale-invariant
58  updates on the matrix + GatedNorm group.
59  - `adamh` (lm_head only).
60  - `adam` (token_embed, router, attn_gate, biases, 1-D norm weights).
61- **No gradient clipping** (`max_grad_norm = None`).
62- **1% warmup**, linear decay to 0, `min_lr_ratio = 0`.
63- LR scaling (fit on the May Recipe sweep, issue #5951, R²=0.996):
64  `muonh_lr = 18.31 · tokens^-0.395 · dim^-0.150 · sqrt(B)`
65  (equivalently `adam_lr = 0.06602 · tokens^-0.395 · dim^-0.150 · sqrt(tpb)`).
66 
67**Loss.**
68- Cross-entropy on the next-token logits.
69- **Final-logit z-loss** (`GrugTrainerConfig.z_loss_weight = 1e-4` by
70  default): adds `z_loss_weight · mean(logsumexp(logits)²)` to stabilise the
71  lm-head softmax.
72- **Router z-loss off** by default (`router_z_loss_coef = 0.0`).
73- No auxiliary load-balancing loss; QB router bias does the balancing.
74 
75**Other.**
76- **Expert parallelism**: `ragged_all_to_all` or ring-based via
77  `levanter.grug.grug_moe.moe_mlp` (default: ring). Default capacity factor 1.0.
78 
79## Scaling heuristic
80 
81[`MoeHeuristic`](./heuristic.py) turns `(budget, hidden_dim)` into model +
82optimizer hyperparameters via `build_model_config(hidden_dim, seq_len)` and
83`build_optimizer_config(batch_size, tokens, hidden_dim, seq_len)`. May Recipe
84refit on the MuonH LR sweep (issue #5951; 17 cells, R²=0.996). All formulas
85anchor at **seq_len = 4096** and write batch effects in terms of
86`tokens_per_batch = batch_size · seq_len`.
87 
88- **LR**: `adam_lr = 0.06602 · tokens^-0.395 · dim^-0.150 · sqrt(B)`,
89  `muonh_lr = (13/3) · adam_lr`.
90- **Compute budget**: `C = 3 · flops_per_token(no_lm_head) · tokens`.
91- **Epsilon**: `epsilon_coeff · sqrt(tokens / tokens_per_batch)`.
92- **Beta1**: fixed at 0.9062.
93- **Beta2**: `clip(0.999^(tpb/131072), 0.95, 0.9999)` (constant-token half-life).
94- **Layer count**: `num_layers ≈ dim / (64 + 4·log2(dim) − 9)` (rounded).
95- **GQA**: largest divisor of `num_heads ≤ num_heads / 4`.
96 
97For the earlier AdamH-tuned heuristic (64 experts, used on the May 2026 1e23
98hero run), see the pre-rename
99[`heuristic.py` on main](https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/8586719b524bf7743ec5034403c7e834505fe73e/experime
>nts/grug/moe/heuristic.py).

105issue #4447) and ran the cell at that budget. These are the baseline runs
106that ablation experiments compare against.

150## Promotion criteria
151 
152Changes can be promoted to this recipe when they demonstrate some combination
153of the following. Typically point 1 is sufficient.
154 
1551. **Passes gate 1 and gate 2** as defined in [`agent.md`](./agent.md) —
156   effective speedup > 1 at all compute-optimal baseline points, and lower
157   projected macro_loss at 1e21 and 1e23.
1582. **Low curvature around the minimum of each isoflop curve** — stable
159   behavior across under- and over-trained regimes, in particular the
160   overtrained regime.
1613. **Stability and scaling improvements** — better routing balance, controlled
162   norm growth, fewer activation outliers. Anything that makes the recipe more
163   robust to scaling, even if loss is neutral at small scale.
164 
165Most promotable changes will land in one of three files:
166 
167- [`model.py`](./model.py) — architecture tweaks (routing, norms, attention,
168  activation functions, expert layout, etc.).
169- [`heuristic.py`](./heuristic.py) — scaling heuristics (LR formula
170  coefficients, depth/width formula, GQA ratio, per-batch-size epsilon/beta2
171  scaling).
172- [`optimizer.py`](./optimizer.py) — optimizer internals (MuonH / AdamH
173  components, parameter-group partitioning, per-group learning rates,
174  weight decay).
175 
176Some discretionary factors may influence the promotion decision even when the
177loss criteria are met — for example, impact on training memory footprint,
178inference latency / KV-cache size, serving compatibility, or interaction effects with other promotable changes.
179

76def _default_num_kv_heads(num_heads: int) -> int:
77    for candidate in range(num_heads // 4, 0, -1):
78        if num_heads % candidate == 0:
79            return candidate
80    return 1

83def _resolve_benchmark_config(environ: Mapping[str, str]) -> BenchmarkConfig:
84    stages = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_STAGES", 4)
85    physical_stages = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_PHYSICAL_STAGES", stages)
86    seq_len = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_SEQ_LEN", 4096)
87    hidden_dim = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_HIDDEN_DIM", 2560)
88    warmup_steps = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_WARMUP_STEPS", 1)
89    profile_start_step = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_PROFILE_START_STEP", warmup_steps)
90    profile_steps = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_PROFILE_STEPS", 0)
91    profile_run_id = environ.get("PIPELINE_PROFILE_RUN_ID")
92    steps = _env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_STEPS", 4)
93    if profile_steps > 0:
94        if not profile_run_id:
95            raise ValueError("PIPELINE_PROFILE_RUN_ID is required when profiling")
96        if profile_start_step + profile_steps > steps:
97            raise ValueError("pipeline profile window must fit within PIPELINE_STEPS")
98 
99    layer_counts_value = environ.get("PIPELINE_LAYERS_PER_STAGE")
100    layer_counts = None if not layer_counts_value else tuple(int(value) for value in layer_counts_value.split(","))
101    memory_threshold_value = environ.get("PIPELINE_RESHARD_THRESHOLD_BYTES")
102    memory_threshold = None if not memory_threshold_value else int(memory_threshold_value)
103    if hidden_dim % 128 != 0:
104        raise ValueError(f"PIPELINE_HIDDEN_DIM must be divisible by 128, got {hidden_dim}")
105    num_heads = hidden_dim // 128
106    num_kv_heads = _default_num_kv_heads(num_heads)
107    return BenchmarkConfig(
108        stages=stages,
109        physical_stages=physical_stages,
110        microbatches=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_MICROBATCHES", 8),
111        batch_size=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_BATCH", 256),
112        seq_len=seq_len,
113        hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
114        intermediate_dim=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_INTERMEDIATE_DIM", math.ceil(hidden_dim / 256) * 128),
115        shared_expert_intermediate_dim=_env_int(
116            environ,
117            "PIPELINE_SHARED_EXPERT_INTERMEDIATE_DIM",
118            hidden_dim,
119        ),
120        num_layers=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_LAYERS", 24),
121        num_experts=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_EXPERTS", 256),
122        top_k=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_TOP_K", 4),
123        expert_axis_size=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_EXPERT_AXIS", 8),
124        vocab_size=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_VOCAB_SIZE", 128_256),
125        num_heads=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_HEADS", num_heads),
126        num_kv_heads=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_KV_HEADS", num_kv_heads),
127        sliding_window=_env_int(environ, "PIPELINE_SLIDING_WINDOW", 2048),
128        qk_mult=_env_float(environ, "PIPELINE_QK_MULT", 1.3),
129        steps=steps,
130        warmup_steps=warmup_steps,
131        profile_start_step=profile_start_step,
132        profile_steps=profile_steps,
133        profile_run_id=profile_run_id,
134        layer_counts=layer_counts,
135        memory_threshold=memory_threshold,
136        mp_policy_string=environ.get("PIPELINE_MP", "params=bfloat16,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16"),
137        remat_mode=environ.get("PIPELINE_REMAT", "recompute_all"),
138        attention_implementation=environ.get("PIPELINE_ATTENTION", "gpu_fa4_cute"),
139        moe_implementation=environ.get("PIPELINE_MOE", "ring"),
140        schedule=PipelineSchedule(environ.get("PIPELINE_SCHEDULE", PipelineSchedule.ZERO_BUBBLE)),
141    )

148def _validate_local_mesh(
149    *,
150    local_device_count: int,
151    expert_axis_size: int,
152    batch_size: int,
153    microbatches: int,
154) -> None:
155    if local_device_count % expert_axis_size != 0:
156        raise ValueError(f"local device count {local_device_count} must be divisible by expert axis {expert_axis_size}")
157    if batch_size % microbatches != 0:
158        raise ValueError(f"batch size {batch_size} must be divisible by {microbatches} microbatches")
159    microbatch_size = batch_size // microbatches
160    if microbatch_size % local_device_count != 0:
161        raise ValueError(
162            f"microbatch size {microbatch_size} must be divisible by the {local_device_count} devices in each stage"
163        )

274        token_row = np.arange(config.seq_len, dtype=np.int32) % model_config.vocab_size
275        host_tokens = np.broadcast_to(token_row, (config.batch_size, config.seq_len)).copy()
276        host_loss_weight = np.ones((config.batch_size, config.seq_len), dtype=np.float32)

281        )

284        if config.schedule == PipelineSchedule.DUALPIPE_V:

292            num_stages=config.stages,

295            memory_threshold=config.memory_threshold,
296        )
297    jax.block_until_ready((state, batches, loss_denominator))
298    _log(

300        process_index=jax.process_index(),
301        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - init_started,
302    )
303 
304    build_started = time.monotonic()
305    step = make_automatic_pipeline_step(
306        optimizer,
307        mp_policy,
308        static_stages,
309        state,
310        batches,
311        config=pipeline_config,
312        mpmd_mesh=mpmd_mesh,
313        schedule_name=config.schedule.automatic_schedule,
314    )
315    _log(

317        process_index=jax.process_index(),
318        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - build_started,
319    )
320    lower_started = time.monotonic()
321    prepared = prepare_automatic_mpmd_step(
322        step,
323        state,
324        batches,
325        loss_denominator,
326        mpmd_mesh,
327        memory_threshold=config.memory_threshold,
328    )
329    step = prepared.step
330    state = prepared.state
331    batches = prepared.batches
332    loss_denominator = prepared.loss_denominator
333    _log(
334        "PIPELINE_LOWER",
335        process_index=jax.process_index(),
336        elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic() - lower_started,
337    )
338 
339    profiler_callback = None
340    if config.profile_steps > 0:
341        from levanter.callbacks.profiler import ProfileOptionsConfig, ProfilerConfig  # noqa: PLC0415
342 
343        profiler_callback = ProfilerConfig(
344            enabled=True,
345            start_step=config.profile_start_step,
346            num_steps=config.profile_steps,
347            perfetto_link=False,
348            profile_options=ProfileOptionsConfig(
349                host_tracer_level=1,
350                python_tracer_level=0,
351                enable_hlo_proto=True,
352            ),
353        ).build(
354            "/tmp/grug-moe-pipeline-profiler",
355            run_id=config.profile_run_id,
356        )
357        profiler_callback(SimpleNamespace(step=-1))
358 
359    step_times = []
360    loss = None
361    for step_index in range(config.steps):
362        started = time.monotonic()
363        state, metrics = step(state, batches, loss_denominator)
364        jax.block_until_ready((state, metrics))
365        elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
366        step_times.append(elapsed)
367        metric_loss = metrics[TRAIN_LOSS_KEY]
368        if profiler_callback is not None:
369            profiler_callback(SimpleNamespace(step=step_index))
370        if isinstance(metric_loss, MpmdArray):
371            if not metric_loss.is_partially_addressable:
372                continue
373            local_loss = metric_loss.to_mpmd_local_array
374            if not isinstance(local_loss, jax.Array):
375                raise TypeError(f"expected one local loss array, got {type(local_loss).__name__}")
376        else:
377            local_loss = metric_loss
378        loss = float(local_loss)
379        _log(
380            "PIPELINE_STEP",
381            step=step_index,
382            elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
383            tokens_per_second=config.batch_size * config.seq_len / elapsed,
384            loss=loss,
385        )
386 
387    measured = step_times[config.warmup_steps :]
388    if not measured:
389        measured = step_times
390    mean_step_seconds = sum(measured) / len(measured)
391    median_step_seconds = statistics.median(measured)
392    tokens_per_second = config.batch_size * config.seq_len / mean_step_seconds
393    median_tokens_per_second = config.batch_size * config.seq_len / median_step_seconds
394    forward_flops_per_token = lm_flops_per_token(
395        hidden_dim=model_config.hidden_dim,
396        intermediate_dim=model_config.intermediate_dim,
397        shared_intermediate_dim=model_config.shared_expert_intermediate_dim,
398        num_layers=model_config.num_layers,
399        num_kv_heads=model_config.num_kv_heads,
400        num_heads=model_config.num_heads,
401        seq_len=model_config.max_seq_len,
402        vocab_size=model_config.vocab_size,
403        glu=True,
404        num_experts=model_config.num_experts,
405        num_shared_experts=1 if model_config.shared_expert_intermediate_dim > 0 else 0,
406        num_experts_per_tok=model_config.num_experts_per_token,
407    )
408    analytic_mfu = 3 * forward_flops_per_token * tokens_per_second / (jax.device_count() * peak_flops_per_device)
409    median_analytic_mfu = (
410        3 * forward_flops_per_token * median_tokens_per_second / (jax.device_count() * peak_flops_per_device)
411    )
412    if loss is not None:
413        _log(
414            "PIPELINE_SUMMARY",
415            mean_step_seconds=mean_step_seconds,
416            median_step_seconds=median_step_seconds,
417            tokens_per_second=tokens_per_second,
418            median_tokens_per_second=median_tokens_per_second,
419            analytic_mfu=analytic_mfu,
420            median_analytic_mfu=median_analytic_mfu,
421            measured_step_seconds=measured,
422            loss=loss,
423            measured_steps=len(measured),
424        )
425 
426    for device in jax.local_devices():
427        stats = device.memory_stats()
428        if stats is not None:
429            _log(
430                "PIPELINE_MEMORY",
431                process_index=jax.process_index(),
432                device_id=device.id,
433                peak_bytes_in_use=stats.get("peak_bytes_in_use"),
434                bytes_limit=stats.get("bytes_limit"),
435            )

74                raise ValueError(f"pipeline parallelism requires at least 2 physical stages, got {self.physical_stages}"
 >)
75            if self.stages != 2 * self.physical_stages:
76                raise ValueError(
77                    "virtual pipeline parallelism requires exactly two logical stages per physical stage; "
78                    f"got {self.stages} logical and {self.physical_stages} physical stages"
79                )
80 
81    @property
82    def mpmd_stages(self) -> int:
83        return self.stages if self.physical_stages is None else self.physical_stages
84 
85 
86def make_pipeline_mesh(
87    config: GrugMoePipelineConfig,
88    *,
89    expert_axis_size: int,
90    replica_axis_size: int | None = None,
91):
92    """Build the concrete Grug mesh and wrap it as a JaxPP MPMD mesh."""
93    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
94    if replica_axis_size is None:
95        replica_axis_size = max(1, jax.process_count() // config.mpmd_stages)
96    fixed_axes = config.mpmd_stages * replica_axis_size * expert_axis_size
97    if jax.device_count() % fixed_axes != 0:
98        raise ValueError(
99            f"device count {jax.device_count()} must be divisible by stages ({config.mpmd_stages}) * "
100            f"replicas ({replica_axis_size}) * experts ({expert_axis_size})"
101        )
102 
103    data_axis_size = jax.device_count() // fixed_axes
104    shape = (config.mpmd_stages, replica_axis_size, data_axis_size, expert_axis_size, 1)
105    axis_names = (_PIPELINE_AXIS, "replica_dcn", "data", "expert", "model")
106    devices = np.asarray(jax.devices(), dtype=object).reshape(shape)
107    mesh = Mesh(devices, axis_names, axis_types=(AxisType.Explicit,) * len(axis_names))
108    if mesh.is_multi_process:
109        local_stages = {int(np.argwhere(devices == device)[0][0]) for device in jax.local_devices()}
110        if len(local_stages) != 1:
111            raise ValueError(f"each JAX process must own exactly one pipeline stage; got {sorted(local_stages)}")
112    return mesh, pp.MpmdMesh(mesh, _PIPELINE_AXIS)
113 
114 
115class GrugMoePipelineStage(eqx.Module):
116    """The parameters and layer range owned by one pipeline stage."""
117 
118    token_embed: jax.Array | None
119    embed_norm: RMSNorm | None
120    embed_gated_norm: GatedNorm | None
121    output_proj: jax.Array | None
122    blocks: tuple[Block, ...]
123    final_norm: RMSNorm | None
124    final_gated_norm: GatedNorm | None
125    config: GrugModelConfig = eqx.field(static=True)
126    stage_index: int = eqx.field(static=True)
127    start_layer: int = eqx.field(static=True)
128    end_layer: int = eqx.field(static=True)
129 
130    @named_call
131    def embed(self, token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"]) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
132        if self.token_embed is None or self.embed_norm is None or self.embed_gated_norm is None:
133            raise ValueError("only stage 0 owns the token embedding")
134        hidden = self.token_embed.at[token_ids].get(out_sharding=P(BATCH_AXES))
135        return self.embed_gated_norm(self.embed_norm(hidden))
136 
137    @named_call
138    def run_blocks(
139        self,
140        hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"],
141        mask: AttentionMask | jax.Array | None,
142    ) -> tuple[Float[Array, "B S D"], dict[str, jax.Array]]:
143        if mask is None:
144            mask = AttentionMask.causal()
145 
146        cfg = self.config
147        segment_ids = mask.segment_ids if isinstance(mask, AttentionMask) else None
148        short_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, sliding_window=cfg.sliding_window, segment_ids=segment_ids)
149        long_mask = AttentionMask(is_causal=True, sliding_window=None, segment_ids=segment_ids)
150        remat_policy = (
151            jax.checkpoint_policies.save_only_these_names(*MOE_REMAT_SAVE_NAMES)
152            if cfg.remat_mode == "save_moe"
153            else None
154        )
155 
156        block_metrics = []
157        for local_index, block in enumerate(self.blocks):
158            layer_index = self.start_layer + local_index
159            is_long = layer_index % 4 == 3 or layer_index == cfg.num_layers - 1
160            layer_mask = long_mask if is_long else short_mask
161            hidden, metrics = eqx.filter_checkpoint(block, policy=remat_policy)(
162                hidden,
163                layer_mask,
164                is_long and not cfg.disable_pko,
165                is_long and cfg.disable_long_rope,
166            )
167            block_metrics.append(metrics)
168 
169        return hidden, _stack_router_metrics(block_metrics)
170 
171    @named_call
172    def finish(self, hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"]) -> Float[Array, "B S D"]:
173        if self.final_norm is None or self.final_gated_norm is None:
174            raise ValueError("only the final stage owns the final norms")
175        return self.final_gated_norm(self.final_norm(hidden))
176 
177    @named_call
178    def cross_entropy_loss(
179        self,
180        hidden: Float[Array, "B S D"],
181        token_ids: Int[Array, "B S"],
182        loss_weight: Float[Array, "B S"],
183        *,
184        logsumexp_weight: float | None,
185        reduction: str = "mean",
186    ) -> jax.Array:
187        if self.output_proj is None:
188            raise ValueError("only the final stage owns the output projection")
189        labels = jnp.pad(token_ids[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1))).astype(jnp.int32)
190        return fused_linear_softmax_cross_entropy_loss(
191            hidden,
192            self.output_proj,
193            labels,
194            weight=loss_weight.astype(jnp.float32),
195            reduction=reduction,
196            logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
197            dtype=jnp.float32,
198        )
199 
200    def local_router_loss(self, router_metrics: dict[str, jax.Array]) -> jax.Array:
201        coefficient = jnp.asarray(self.config.router_z_loss_coef / self.config.num_layers, dtype=jnp.float32)
202        return coefficient * jnp.sum(router_metrics["router_z_loss_per_layer"])
203

231def split_transformer(
232    model: Transformer,
233    num_stages: int,
234    *,
235    layer_counts: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
236) -> tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]:
237    """Split a Grug MoE transformer into contiguous stage pytrees."""
238    if layer_counts is None:
239        ranges = evenly_partition_layers(len(model.blocks), num_stages)
240    else:
241        if len(layer_counts) != num_stages:
242            raise ValueError(f"expected {num_stages} layer counts, got {len(layer_counts)}")
243        if any(count <= 0 for count in layer_counts):
244            raise ValueError(f"layer counts must be positive, got {layer_counts}")
245        if sum(layer_counts) != len(model.blocks):
246            raise ValueError(f"layer counts sum to {sum(layer_counts)}, but model has {len(model.blocks)} layers")
247        boundaries = np.cumsum((0, *layer_counts))
248        ranges = tuple((int(start), int(end)) for start, end in itertools.pairwise(boundaries))
249    stages = []
250    for stage_index, (start_layer, end_layer) in enumerate(ranges):
251        is_first = stage_index == 0
252        is_last = stage_index == num_stages - 1
253        stages.append(
254            GrugMoePipelineStage(
255                token_embed=model.token_embed if is_first else None,
256                embed_norm=model.embed_norm if is_first else None,
257                embed_gated_norm=model.embed_gated_norm if is_first else None,
258                output_proj=model.output_proj if is_last else None,
259                blocks=model.blocks[start_layer:end_layer],
260                final_norm=model.final_norm if is_last else None,
261                final_gated_norm=model.final_gated_norm if is_last else None,
262                config=model.config,
263                stage_index=stage_index,
264                start_layer=start_layer,
265                end_layer=end_layer,
266            )
267        )
268    return tuple(stages)
269 
270 
271def merge_stages(stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]) -> Transformer:
272    """Reassemble stage-local parameters into the ordinary Grug model pytree."""
273    if len(stages) < 2:
274        raise ValueError("at least two pipeline stages are required")
275    for expected_index, stage in enumerate(stages):
276        if stage.stage_index != expected_index:
277            raise ValueError(f"expected stage {expected_index}, got {stage.stage_index}")
278 
279    first = stages[0]
280    last = stages[-1]
281    if first.token_embed is None or first.embed_norm is None or first.embed_gated_norm is None:
282        raise ValueError("stage 0 is missing embedding parameters")
283    if last.output_proj is None or last.final_norm is None or last.final_gated_norm is None:
284        raise ValueError("final stage is missing output parameters")
285    return Transformer(
286        token_embed=first.token_embed,
287        embed_norm=first.embed_norm,
288        embed_gated_norm=first.embed_gated_norm,
289        output_proj=last.output_proj,
290        blocks=tuple(block for stage in stages for block in stage.blocks),
291        final_norm=last.final_norm,
292        final_gated_norm=last.final_gated_norm,
293        config=first.config,
294    )
295 
296 
297def split_automatic_stages(
298    model: Transformer,
299    *,
300    num_stages: int,
301    layer_counts: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
302) -> tuple[tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...], tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]]:
303    """Partition automatic-schedule stages into trainable and static pytrees.
304 
305    Returns:
306        The trainable and static stage tuples. Router biases remain static
307        because the pending QB update supplies them separately.
308    """
309    stages = split_transformer(model, num_stages, layer_counts=layer_counts)
310    trainable_stages = []
311    static_stages = []
312    for stage in stages:
313        trainable_stage, static_stage = eqx.partition(stage, eqx.is_array)
314        for block_index in range(len(stage.blocks)):
315            trainable_stage = eqx.tree_at(
316                lambda current, index=block_index: current.blocks[index].mlp.router_bias,
317                trainable_stage,
318                None,
319            )
320        trainable_stages.append(trainable_stage)
321        static_stages.append(static_stage)
322    return tuple(trainable_stages), tuple(static_stages)
323 
324 
325def _process_has_sharding(sharding: NamedSharding) -> bool:
326    process_index = jax.process_index()
327    return any(device.process_index == process_index for device in sharding.mesh.devices.flat)
328 
329 
330def _empty_sharded_array(shape: tuple[int, ...], dtype, sharding: NamedSharding) -> jax.Array:
331    return jax.make_array_from_single_device_arrays(shape, sharding, [], dtype=dtype)
332 
333 
334def _stage_local_scalar(value: jax.Array, sharding: NamedSharding) -> jax.Array:
335    if not _process_has_sharding(sharding):
336        return _empty_sharded_array((), value.dtype, sharding)
337    return jax.device_put(np.asarray(value), sharding)
338 
339 
340def _localize_optimizer_scalars(mpmd_mesh, stage_index: int, opt_state):
341    stage_mesh = mpmd_mesh.unstack[stage_index]
342 
343    def localize(value):
344        if _is_array(value) and value.shape == ():
345            return _stage_local_scalar(value, NamedSharding(stage_mesh, P()))
346        return value
347 
348    return jax.tree.map(localize, opt_state)
349 
350 
351def _initialize_mpmd_stage_state(
352    stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
353    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
354    mpmd_mesh,
355    stage_to_mpmd_index: tuple[int, ...],
356    memory_threshold: int | None,
357) -> _InitializedMpmdStageState:
358    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
359    qb_targets = tuple(
360        pp.MpmdSharding(mpmd_mesh, mesh_ids={mpmd_index}, spec=P(None, None)) for mpmd_index in stage_to_mpmd_index
361    )
362    pending_qb_betas = pp.spmd_to_mpmd_reshard(
363        mpmd_mesh,
364        tuple(jnp.zeros((len(stage.blocks), stage.config.num_experts), dtype=jnp.float32) for stage in stages),
365        qb_targets,
366        threshold=memory_threshold,
367    )
368    opt_state = tuple(
369        _localize_optimizer_scalars(mpmd_mesh, mpmd_index, optimizer.init(stage))
370        for mpmd_index, stage in zip(stage_to_mpmd_index, stages, strict=True)
371    )
372    step = _stage_local_scalar(jnp.array(0, dtype=jnp.int32), NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.unstack[0], P()))
373    return _InitializedMpmdStageState(
374        step=step,
375        opt_state=opt_state,
376        pending_qb_betas=pending_qb_betas,
377    )
378

380def make_mpmd_automatic_pipeline_state(
381    model: Transformer,
382    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
383    mpmd_mesh,
384    *,
385    num_stages: int,
386    layer_counts: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
387    stage_to_mpmd_index: tuple[int, ...] | None = None,
388    memory_threshold: int | None = None,
389) -> tuple[GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState, tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...]]:
390    """Return automatic state and static stages using the requested placement."""
391    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
392    if stage_to_mpmd_index is None:
393        stage_to_mpmd_index = tuple(range(num_stages))
394    if len(stage_to_mpmd_index) != num_stages:
395        raise ValueError(f"expected {num_stages} stage placements, got {len(stage_to_mpmd_index)}")
396    trainable_stages, static_stages = split_automatic_stages(
397        model,
398        num_stages=num_stages,
399        layer_counts=layer_counts,
400    )
401    trainable_targets = tuple(
402        _mpmd_sharding_tree(mpmd_mesh, mpmd_index, stage)
403        for mpmd_index, stage in zip(stage_to_mpmd_index, trainable_stages, strict=True)
404    )
405    trainable_stages = pp.spmd_to_mpmd_reshard(
406        mpmd_mesh,
407        trainable_stages,
408        trainable_targets,
409        threshold=memory_threshold,
410    )
411    initialized = _initialize_mpmd_stage_state(
412        trainable_stages,
413        optimizer,
414        mpmd_mesh,
415        stage_to_mpmd_index,
416        memory_threshold,
417    )
418    return (
419        GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState(
420            step=initialized.step,
421            trainable_params=trainable_stages,
422            opt_state=initialized.opt_state,
423            pending_qb_betas=initialized.pending_qb_betas,
424        ),
425        static_stages,
426    )
427

429def staged_loss(
430    stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
431    batch: GrugLmExample,
432    *,
433    logsumexp_weight: float | None = None,
434) -> jax.Array:
435    """Return the loss from sequential execution of split stages."""
436    hidden = stages[0].embed(batch.tokens)
437    router_loss = jnp.array(0.0, dtype=jnp.float32)
438    for stage in stages:
439        hidden, metrics = stage.run_blocks(hidden, batch.attn_mask)
440        router_loss = router_loss + stage.local_router_loss(metrics)
441    hidden = stages[-1].finish(hidden)
442    return (
443        stages[-1].cross_entropy_loss(
444            hidden,
445            batch.tokens,
446            batch.loss_weight,
447            logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
448        )
449        + router_loss
450    )
451 
452 
453def microbatched_staged_loss(
454    stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
455    batch: GrugLmExample,
456    *,
457    num_microbatches: int,
458    logsumexp_weight: float | None = None,
459) -> jax.Array:
460    """Return the loss after sequential microbatch accumulation."""
461    cross_entropy_sum = jnp.array(0.0, dtype=jnp.float32)
462    loss_denominator = jnp.array(0.0, dtype=jnp.float32)
463    router_loss = jnp.array(0.0, dtype=jnp.float32)
464    for microbatch in split_batch_into_microbatches(batch, num_microbatches):
465        hidden = stages[0].embed(microbatch.tokens)
466        for stage in stages:
467            hidden, metrics = stage.run_blocks(hidden, microbatch.attn_mask)
468            router_loss = router_loss + stage.local_router_loss(metrics) / num_microbatches
469        hidden = stages[-1].finish(hidden)
470        cross_entropy_sum = cross_entropy_sum + stages[-1].cross_entropy_loss(
471            hidden,
472            microbatch.tokens,
473            microbatch.loss_weight,
474            logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
475            reduction="sum",
476        )
477        loss_denominator = loss_denominator + jnp.sum(microbatch.loss_weight.astype(jnp.float32))
478    cross_entropy = jnp.where(
479        loss_denominator != 0,
480        cross_entropy_sum / loss_denominator,
481        jnp.zeros_like(cross_entropy_sum),
482    )
483    return cross_entropy + router_loss
484 
485 
486def _stack_router_metrics(block_metrics: list[dict[str, jax.Array]]) -> dict[str, jax.Array]:
487    keys = (
488        "routing_entropy",
489        "routing_counts",
490        "load_balancing_loss",
491        "router_z_loss",
492        "qb_beta",
493        "capacity_overflow",
494    )
495    return {f"{key}_per_layer": jnp.stack([metrics[key] for metrics in block_metrics]) for key in keys}
496 
497 
498def _apply_qb_betas(stage: GrugMoePipelineStage, qb_betas: jax.Array) -> GrugMoePipelineStage:
499    blocks = list(stage.blocks)
500    for index, block in enumerate(blocks):
501        new_bias = -qb_betas[index]
502        new_bias = new_bias - jnp.mean(new_bias)
503        new_mlp = eqx.tree_at(lambda mlp: mlp.router_bias, block.mlp, new_bias)
504        blocks[index] = eqx.tree_at(lambda current: current.mlp, block, new_mlp)
505    return eqx.tree_at(lambda current: current.blocks, stage, tuple(blocks))
506 
507 
508def _jaxpp_modules():
509    if jaxpp is None or mpmd is None:
510        raise ModuleNotFoundError("The canonical Grug pipeline requires `uv sync --extra pipeline`.")
511    return jaxpp, mpmd
512

514def automatic_stage_to_mpmd_indices(
515    config: GrugMoePipelineConfig,
516    schedule_name: AutomaticPipelineSchedule,
517) -> tuple[int, ...]:
518    """Return the physical MPMD rank that owns each logical automatic stage."""
519    schedule = _automatic_schedule(config, schedule_name)
520    return tuple(int(schedule.get_mpmd_idx(stage_index)) for stage_index in range(config.stages))
521 
522 
523def _automatic_schedule(config: GrugMoePipelineConfig, schedule_name: AutomaticPipelineSchedule):
524    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
525    if schedule_name == AutomaticPipelineSchedule.ZERO_BUBBLE:
526        return pp.ZeroBubble(num_stages=config.stages)
527    if schedule_name == AutomaticPipelineSchedule.DUALPIPE_V:
528        return pp.DualPipeV(num_stages=config.stages, mpmd_dim=config.mpmd_stages)
529    raise ValueError(f"unknown automatic pipeline schedule: {schedule_name}")
530 
531 
532def _is_array(value: object) -> TypeGuard[_ArrayValue]:
533    if isinstance(value, (jax.Array, jax.ShapeDtypeStruct)):
534        return True
535    return jaxpp is not None and isinstance(value, jaxpp.MpmdArray)
536 
537 
538def _partition_spec_tree(tree):
539    def partition_spec(value):
540        if not _is_array(value):
541            return None
542        if isinstance(value.sharding, NamedSharding):
543            return value.sharding.spec
544        if jaxpp is not None and isinstance(value.sharding, jaxpp.MpmdSharding):
545            return value.sharding.spec
546        return P(*([None] * value.ndim))
547 
548    return jax.tree.map(partition_spec, tree)
549 
550 
551def _mpmd_sharding_tree(mpmd_mesh, stage_index: int, tree):
552    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
553 
554    def sharding(value):
555        if not _is_array(value):
556            return None
557        spec = value.sharding.spec if isinstance(value.sharding, NamedSharding) else P(*([None] * value.ndim))
558        return pp.MpmdSharding(mpmd_mesh, mesh_ids={stage_index}, spec=spec)
559 
560    return jax.tree.map(sharding, tree)

563def make_automatic_pipeline_step(
564    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
565    mp_policy: jmp.Policy,
566    static_stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...],
567    sample_state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
568    sample_batches: GrugLmExample,
569    *,
570    config: GrugMoePipelineConfig,
571    mpmd_mesh,
572    schedule_name: AutomaticPipelineSchedule = AutomaticPipelineSchedule.ZERO_BUBBLE,
573    logsumexp_weight: float | None = None,
574):
575    """Build a JaxPP automatic ZeroBubble or DualPipeV optimizer step.
576 
577    ``static_stages`` and ``sample_state`` must come from the same automatic
578    state initializer. ``sample_batches`` must have the leading microbatch axis
579    produced by :func:`levanter.pipeline.reshape_batch_into_microbatches`.
580 
581    """
582    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
583    schedule = _automatic_schedule(config, schedule_name)
584 
585    def pipeline_step(
586        state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
587        batches: GrugLmExample,
588        loss_denominator: jax.Array,
589    ):
590        def loss_fn(trainable_stages: tuple[GrugMoePipelineStage, ...], batch: GrugLmExample):
591            hidden = None
592            router_loss = jnp.array(0.0, dtype=jnp.float32)
593            next_qb_betas = []
594            last_stage = None
595            for stage_index, (trainable_stage, static_stage) in enumerate(
596                zip(trainable_stages, static_stages, strict=True)
597            ):
598                stage = eqx.combine(trainable_stage, static_stage)
599                stage = mp_policy.cast_to_compute(_apply_qb_betas(stage, state.pending_qb_betas[stage_index]))
600                if stage_index == 0:
601                    hidden = stage.embed(batch.tokens)
602                assert hidden is not None
603                hidden, router_metrics = stage.run_blocks(hidden, batch.attn_mask)
604                router_loss = router_loss + stage.local_router_loss(router_metrics) / config.microbatches
605                next_qb_betas.append(router_metrics[_QB_BETA_PER_LAYER_KEY])
606                if stage_index < config.stages - 1:
607                    hidden = pp.mark_stage_end(hidden)
608                last_stage = stage
609 
610            assert last_stage is not None
611            hidden = last_stage.finish(hidden)
612            cross_entropy_sum = last_stage.cross_entropy_loss(
613                hidden,
614                batch.tokens,
615                batch.loss_weight,
616                logsumexp_weight=logsumexp_weight,
617                reduction="sum",
618            )
619            loss = cross_entropy_sum / loss_denominator + router_loss
620            loss = pp.mark_stage_end(loss)
621            return loss, tuple(next_qb_betas)
622 
623        (loss, next_qb_betas), grads = pp.treduce(
624            lambda batch: jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn, has_aux=True)(state.trainable_params, batch),
625            batches,
626            schedule=schedule,
627            operation=((pp.Add, tuple(pp.Add for _ in range(config.stages))), pp.Add),
628        )
629        next_params = []
630        next_opt_state = []
631        for params, opt_state, stage_grads in zip(
632            state.trainable_params,
633            state.opt_state,
634            grads,
635            strict=True,
636        ):
637            updates, stage_opt_state = optimizer.update(stage_grads, opt_state, params)
638            next_params.append(eqx.apply_updates(params, updates))
639            next_opt_state.append(stage_opt_state)
640        next_state = dataclasses.replace(
641            state,
642            step=state.step + jnp.array(1, dtype=state.step.dtype),
643            trainable_params=tuple(next_params),
644            opt_state=tuple(next_opt_state),
645            pending_qb_betas=tuple(beta / config.microbatches for beta in next_qb_betas),
646        )
647        return next_state, {TRAIN_LOSS_KEY: loss}
648 
649    return pp.mpmd_jit_with_loop(
650        pipeline_step,
651        mpmd_mesh=mpmd_mesh,
652        in_specs=(_partition_spec_tree(sample_state), _partition_spec_tree(sample_batches), P()),
653        out_specs=(_partition_spec_tree(sample_state), {TRAIN_LOSS_KEY: P()}),
654    )
655 
656 
657def prepare_automatic_mpmd_step(
658    step,
659    state: GrugMoeAutomaticPipelineState,
660    batches: GrugLmExample,
661    loss_denominator: jax.Array,
662    mpmd_mesh,
663    *,
664    memory_threshold: int | None = None,
665) -> PreparedAutomaticMpmdStep:
666    """Compile with stage-local state and place only the still-SPMD batch inputs."""
667    pp, _ = _jaxpp_modules()
668    compiled = step.compile(state, batches, loss_denominator)
669    args_shardings, kwargs_shardings = compiled.in_shardings
670    if kwargs_shardings:
671        raise ValueError("automatic pipeline step does not accept keyword arguments")
672 
673    def place_initial_scalar(value, target):
674        if not _is_array(value) or isinstance(value, pp.MpmdArray):
675            return value
676        if value.shape != ():
677            return value
678        mesh_ids = target.mesh_ids or {0}
679        local_arrays = []
680        for stage_index in sorted(mesh_ids):
681            sharding = NamedSharding(mpmd_mesh.unstack[stage_index], target.spec)
682            if _process_has_sharding(sharding):
683                local_arrays.append(jax.device_put(np.zeros((), dtype=value.dtype), sharding))
684        return pp.MpmdArray(
685            local_arrays,
686            target,
687            shape=(),
688            dtype=value.dtype,
689        )
690 
691    state = jax.tree.map(place_initial_scalar, state, args_shardings[0])
692    if memory_threshold is None and all(device.memory_stats() is None for device in jax.local_devices()):
693        memory_threshold = 0
694    batches, loss_denominator = pp.spmd_to_mpmd_reshard(
695        mpmd_mesh,
696        (batches, loss_denominator),
697        (args_shardings[1], args_shardings[2]),
698        threshold=memory_threshold,
699    )
700    return PreparedAutomaticMpmdStep(
701        step=compiled,
702        state=state,
703        batches=batches,
704        loss_denominator=loss_denominator,
705    )

4# Local copy of AdamH for iteration without modifying Levanter.
5# Adapted from levanter.optim.adamh.

7from typing import Any, NamedTuple
8 
9import chex
10import jax
11import jax.numpy as jnp
12import optax
13from optax import tree_utils as otu
14 
15 
16class ScaleByAdamHState(NamedTuple):
17    count: chex.Array
18    mu: optax.Updates
19    nu: optax.Updates
20 
21 
22def scale_by_adamh(
23    b1: float = 0.9,
24    b2: float = 0.999,
25    eps: float = 1e-8,
26    learning_rate: float = 0.02,
27    mu_dtype: Any | None = None,
28) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
29    mu_dtype = jax.dtypes.canonicalize_dtype(mu_dtype)
30 
31    def init_fn(params):
32        mu = otu.tree_zeros_like(params, dtype=mu_dtype)
33        nu = otu.tree_zeros_like(params)
34        return ScaleByAdamHState(count=jnp.zeros([], jnp.int32), mu=mu, nu=nu)
35 
36    def update_fn(updates, state, params):
37        mu = otu.tree_update_moment(updates, state.mu, b1, 1)
38        nu = otu.tree_update_moment_per_elem_norm(updates, state.nu, b2, 2)
39        count_inc = optax.safe_increment(state.count)
40        mu_hat = otu.tree_bias_correction(mu, b1, count_inc)
41        nu_hat = otu.tree_bias_correction(nu, b2, count_inc)
42 
43        adam_updates = jax.tree.map(
44            lambda m, v: None if m is None else m / (jnp.sqrt(v) + eps),
45            mu_hat,
46            nu_hat,
47            is_leaf=lambda x: x is None,
48        )
49        mu = otu.tree_cast(mu, mu_dtype)
50 
51        def _scale_invariant_2d(p, u):
52            """Core update for a 2-D (matrix) parameter."""
53            p_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(p)
54            u_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(u)
55            new_p = p - learning_rate * u * p_norm / jnp.maximum(u_norm, 1e-10)
56            return new_p / jnp.linalg.norm(new_p) * p_norm - p
57 
58        def scale_invariant_update(p, u):
59            if p is None:
60                return None
61            if p.ndim <= 2:
62                return _scale_invariant_2d(p, u)
63            # For higher-rank tensors, vmap the 2-D logic over the leading axis.
64            return jax.vmap(_scale_invariant_2d)(p, u)
65 
66        adamh_updates = jax.tree_util.tree_map(
67            scale_invariant_update,
68            params,
69            adam_updates,
70            is_leaf=lambda x: x is None,
71        )
72 
73        return adamh_updates, ScaleByAdamHState(count=count_inc, mu=mu, nu=nu)
74 
75    return optax.GradientTransformation(init_fn, update_fn)
76 
77 
78__all__ = ["ScaleByAdamHState", "scale_by_adamh"]

t1# Agent Guide: experiments/grug/moet
2 
3## Autonomy
4 
5This workflow is designed to run end-to-end without human confirmation. The
6agent is authorized to:
7 
8- Create branches, commit, and push without asking
9- Create GitHub experiment issues and post comments
10- Submit Iris jobs and kill only jobs submitted by self
11- Run experiments through both gates autonomously
12 
13Do not stop to ask for confirmation at any step. If something fails, diagnose
14and retry or report the failure — do not block waiting for input.
15 
16## Objective
17 
18Determine whether a proposed change outperforms the baseline. Baseline results
19are in `experiments/grug/moe/README.md` — compare against the table there.
20 
21**Metrics (from wandb):**
22- `eval/paloma/macro_loss` (final value)
23- `throughput/tokens_per_second` (averaged over the last 100 steps)
24- `throughput/total_tokens` (final value)
25- `run.state` must be `finished` before pulling final metrics
26 
27**Baseline scaling law** (May Recipe, drop-1e18 fit, L∞ pinned at 1.6):
28 
29```
30loss(C) = 1.6 + 88.32 · C^(-0.0941)
31```
32 
33### Gate 1: effective speedup at two small scales
34 
35Run the variant at `d512` (3.82e17 FLOPs) and `d768` (2.81e18 FLOPs).
36 
37For each scale, compute the **effective speedup** at a fixed macro_loss target
38(use the baseline's final macro_loss at that scale as the target). The variant
39passes gate 1 if it shows an effective speedup at **both** scales.
40 
41### Gate 2: scaling law projection
42 
43Run the variant at the two larger scales: `d1024` (1.16e19) and `d1280`
44(3.46e19). Combine with the gate 1 results (d512, d768) for four total points.
45 
46The variant passes gate 2 if:
471. It shows an effective speedup at **all four** scales.
482. Fit a new scaling law `loss(C) = 1.6 + A · C^(-alpha)` (asymptote pinned
49   at 1.6) on the variant's four optima. Project to 1e21 and 1e23 FLOPs.
50   The variant's projected loss must be lower than the baseline's at both
51   budgets (baseline: 2.534 at 1e21, 2.205 at 1e23).
52 
53### Effective speedup calculation
54 
55The question: how much faster (in wall-clock time) does the variant reach
56its final loss compared to how long the baseline would need to reach that
57same loss?
58 
59The scaling law `loss(C) = 1.6 + A · C^(-0.0941)` has a fixed exponent but
60the coefficient A varies. We recenter A to pass through the baseline's
61actual (budget, loss) point, then invert to find how much compute the
62baseline would need to match the variant's loss. Finally, compare wall-clock
63times.
64 
65```python
66def effective_speedup(baseline_loss, baseline_tps, variant_loss, variant_tps, budget):
67    """Wall-clock speedup of the variant over the baseline.
68 
69    Returns > 1 if the variant reaches its loss faster in real time.
70    """
71    L_inf = 1.6
72    alpha = 0.0941
73 
74    # 1. Fit the scaling law coefficient through the baseline's data point.
75    #    loss = L_inf + A_bl * C^(-alpha)  =>  A_bl = (loss - L_inf) * C^alpha
76    A_bl = (baseline_loss - L_inf) * budget ** alpha
77 
78    # 2. How much compute would the baseline need to reach variant's loss?
79    C_needed = (A_bl / (variant_loss - L_inf)) ** (1 / alpha)
80 
81    # 3. Compare wall-clock times:
82    #    baseline_time = C_needed / baseline_tps
83    #    variant_time  = budget / variant_tps
84    return (C_needed / baseline_tps) / (budget / variant_tps)
85```
86 
87### Example
88 
89Suppose at d512 / 3.82e17 FLOPs (May Recipe d=512 compute-optimal point):
90- **Baseline**: macro_loss = 3.5422, tok/s = 433,986 (v4-32 EP=1 reference run)
91- **Variant**: macro_loss = 3.52, tok/s = 410,000 (better loss, ~5% slower)
92 
93```python
94# 1. Fit A through baseline point
95A_bl = (3.5422 - 1.6) * (3.82e17) ** 0.0941  # ≈ 87.7
96 
97# 2. Compute baseline needs to reach 3.52
98C_needed = (A_bl / (3.52 - 1.6)) ** (1 / 0.0941)  # > 3.82e17
99 
100# 3. Wall-clock comparison
101baseline_time = C_needed / 433_986
102variant_time  = 3.82e17 / 410_000
103speedup = baseline_time / variant_time
104```
105 
106If the quality improvement (needing more baseline compute to match) outweighs
107the throughput cost (variant taking longer per FLOP), speedup > 1.
108 
109## Implementation
110 
111Most promotable changes will land in one of three files:
112 
113- `model.py` — architecture tweaks (routing, norms, attention, activation functions, expert layout, etc.).
114- `heuristic.py` — scaling heuristics (LR formula coefficients, depth/width formula, GQA ratio, per-batch-size epsilon/b
>eta2 scaling). 
115- `optimizer.py` — optimizer internals (AdamH components, parameter-group partitioning, per-group learning rates, weight
> decay). 
116 
117## Documentation & GitHub Issues
118 
119Create a new branch for each experiment issue. Branch off `main`.
120 
121Follow `.agents/skills/run-research/SKILL.md` for all documentation, logbooks,
122W&B tracking, and GitHub experiment issue management tied to work in this
123directory. Pay attention to this file carefully.
124 
125Experiment issues should be titled `Agent MoE Experiment: [description]`.
126Include the exact prompt from the user that initiated the experiment in the
127issue body.
128 
129After creating the issue, **add it as a sub-issue of #4281** (April 2026 MoE
130scaling tracking issue) using the GitHub GraphQL API. This is required — do not skip it. First get the node IDs, then
131call `addSubIssue`:
132 
133```bash
134# 1. Get node IDs for the parent and the new issue
135gh api graphql -f query='
136query {
137  repository(owner: "marin-community", name: "marin") {
138    parent: issue(number: 4281) { id }
139    child: issue(number: <NEW_ISSUE_NUMBER>) { id }
140  }
141}'
142 
143# 2. Add the sub-issue relationship
144gh api graphql -f query='
145mutation {
146  addSubIssue(input: {issueId: "<PARENT_ID>", subIssueId: "<CHILD_ID>"}) {
147    issue { number }
148    subIssue { number }
149  }
150}'
151```
152 
153## Authentication
154 
155Assume the user has already completed these before job submission:
156- `WANDB_API_KEY` set in the environment
157- `gcloud auth login` and `gcloud auth application-default login`
158 
159## Job Submission
160 
161Jobs in this directory are submitted to **Iris** on a **v5p-8**.
162 
163### Submission command
164 
165```bash
166.venv/bin/iris --cluster=marin job run \
167  --no-wait \
168  --reserve v5p-8 \
169  -e WANDB_API_KEY "$WANDB_API_KEY" \
170  -- python -m experiments.grug.moe.launch --version dev --run
171```
172 
173Swap the module path (`experiments.grug.moe.launch`) for whichever launch
174script in this directory you are running. Every launch script takes the shared
175experiment CLI (`marin.experiment.cli`): `--version` sets the checkpoint version
176(required; `dev` to iterate, a calendar `YYYY.MM.DD` to keep), and `--run` builds
177the trial — without it the lowered plan is printed and nothing runs.
178 
179`--reserve v5p-8` is a hard zone constraint (confines the job to a zone where a
180v5p-8 has actually been obtained, waiting otherwise), not a capacity reservation
181— it does not hold or guarantee capacity.
182 
183### Monitoring
184 
185Runs may take time to find a TPU, and 5–10 minutes to start once scheduled.
186After confirming the run is progressing on wandb, jobs typically take over an
187hour to complete. Sleep at reasonable intervals (e.g. 15 minutes) before
188checking status — do not poll in a tight loop.
189 
190Reconnect to logs:
191```bash
192.venv/bin/iris --cluster=marin job logs -f JOB_ID
193```
194 
195List your jobs:
196```bash
197.venv/bin/iris --cluster=marin job list | grep "$(whoami)"
198```
199 
200Check runs in wandb (match `<PREFIX>` to the run_id pattern in `launch.py`):
201```python
202import wandb
203api = wandb.Api()
204runs = api.runs('marin-community/marin_moe', filters={'displayName': {'$regex': '^<PREFIX>'}}, order='-created_at')
205for r in runs:
206    print(f'{r.name:<50} state={r.state:<10} step={r.summary.get("global_step", "n/a")}')
207```

4"""Compute-scaling heuristic for MoE — May Recipe (MuonH, 256 experts).
5 
6Refit on the May Recipe LR sweep (issue #5951: 17 cells across
7d ∈ {512, 768, 1024, 1280}, MuonH optimizer, R²=0.996), and is the
8current default for compute-optimal cells and ablation comparisons.
9All empirical fits were measured on runs with seq_len=4096; the
10formulas are written in terms of ``tokens_per_batch = batch_size *
11seq_len`` so they generalise to other sequence lengths, though the
12coefficients are an extrapolation beyond 4096.
13 
14For the earlier AdamH-tuned heuristic (64 experts), see the pre-rename
15``experiments/grug/moe/heuristic.py`` on main:
16https://github.com/marin-community/marin/blob/8586719b524bf7743ec5034403c7e834505fe73e/experiments/grug/moe/heuristic.py
17 
18Formulas:
19- Adam LR: ``adam_lr = lr_coeff * tokens^lr_tokens_exp * dim^lr_dim_exp * sqrt(B)``
20  (``lr_coeff = 0.06602``, ``lr_tokens_exp = -0.395``, ``lr_dim_exp = -0.150``)
21- MuonH/AdamH LR: ``lr = (13/3) * adam_lr``
22- Compute budget convention: ``C = 3 * flops_per_token(no_lm_head) * tokens``
23- Epsilon: ``epsilon = epsilon_base * sqrt(r0/r)`` where ``r = (B*T0)/(B0*T)``
24- Beta1: fixed at ``0.9062``
25- Beta2: ``beta2 = clip(beta2_base^(B/B0), min_beta2, max_beta2)``
26"""
27 
28import math
29from dataclasses import dataclass
30 
31from levanter.utils.flop_utils import lm_flops_per_token
32 
33from experiments.grug.moe.model import GrugModelConfig
34from experiments.grug.moe.optimizer import GrugMoeMuonHConfig
35 
36SEQ_LEN: int = 8192
37MIN_BATCH_SIZE: int = 32
38DEFAULT_TARGET_STEPS: int = 2**14
39 
40 
41def _round_to_power_of_two(x: float) -> int:
42    if x <= 1:
43        return 1
44    return 2 ** math.ceil(math.log2(x))
45 
46 
47def compute_flops_per_token(cfg: GrugModelConfig) -> float:
48    """Non-embedding FLOPs per token (excludes lm_head)."""
49    fpt_with_lm_head = lm_flops_per_token(
50        hidden_dim=cfg.hidden_dim,
51        intermediate_dim=cfg.intermediate_dim,
52        num_layers=cfg.num_layers,
53        num_kv_heads=cfg.num_kv_heads,
54        num_heads=cfg.num_heads,
55        seq_len=cfg.max_seq_len,
56        vocab_size=cfg.vocab_size,
57        glu=True,
58        num_experts=cfg.num_experts,
59        num_shared_experts=1 if cfg.shared_expert_intermediate_dim > 0 else 0,
60        num_experts_per_tok=cfg.num_experts_per_token,
61        shared_intermediate_dim=cfg.shared_expert_intermediate_dim,
62    )
63    return fpt_with_lm_head - 2 * cfg.hidden_dim * cfg.vocab_size
64 
65 
66def compute_tokens_and_batch(
67    budget: float,
68    flops_per_token: float,
69    target_steps: int = DEFAULT_TARGET_STEPS,
70    min_batch_size: int = MIN_BATCH_SIZE,
71    seq_len: int = SEQ_LEN,
72) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
73    """Derive (tokens, batch_size, num_steps) from a compute budget and FLOPs-per-token.
74 
75    ``seq_len`` controls the sequence length used to convert between batch_size
76    (sequences) and tokens_per_batch (tokens per step). All downstream formulas
77    that depend on batch size use ``tokens_per_batch = batch_size * seq_len``
78    so they work correctly at any sequence length.
79    """
80    tokens = budget / (3 * flops_per_token)
81    batch_exact = tokens / (target_steps * seq_len)
82    batch_size = max(min_batch_size, _round_to_power_of_two(batch_exact))
83    train_steps = max(1, round(tokens / (batch_size * seq_len)))
84    return tokens, batch_size, train_steps
85 
86 
87@dataclass(frozen=True)
88class MoeHeuristic:
89    """Compute-scaling heuristic for MoE models (May Recipe refit).
90 
91    Returns a ``MuonH`` optimizer config via ``build_optimizer_config``.
92 
93    ``adam_lr  = lr_coeff * tokens^lr_tokens_exp * dim^lr_dim_exp * sqrt(tokens_per_batch)``
94    ``muonh_lr = muonh_ratio * adam_lr``
95    ``C       = 3 * flops_per_token * tokens``  (flops_per_token excludes lm_head)
96    """
97 
98    # --- LR scaling ---
99    # May Recipe refit (issue #5951; 17 cells across d{512,768,1024,1280},
100    # R^2=0.996):  muonh_lr = 18.31 * tokens^-0.395 * dim^-0.150 * sqrt(B).
101    lr_coeff: float = 0.06602
102    lr_tokens_exp: float = -0.395
103    lr_dim_exp: float = -0.150
104    muonh_ratio: float = 13 / 3
105 
106    # --- Base hyperparameters ---
107    epsilon_coeff: float = 9.676e-18
108    beta1: float = 0.9062
109    beta2_base: float = 0.999
110    beta2_reference_tpb: int = 131_072  # beta2 = beta2_base^(tpb / beta2_reference_tpb)
111 
112    # --- Fixed hyperparameters ---
113    max_grad_norm: float = 1.0
114 
115    # --- Schedule ---
116    min_lr_ratio: float = 0.05
117    lr_schedule: str = "linear"
118    decay: float | None = None
119 
120    # --- Architecture ---
121    vocab_size: int = 128_256
122    hidden_head_ratio: int = 128
123    gqa_ratio: int | None = 4  # None = MHA, 4 = 4:1 GQA, etc.
124    base_hidden_layer_ratio: int = 64
125    layer_scaling_factor: float = 4.0
126    layer_formula_offset: int = 9
127 
128    # --- Constraints ---
129    max_learning_rate: float = 0.05
130    min_beta2: float = 0.95
131    max_beta2: float = 0.9999
132 
133    def _compute_adam_lr(self, tokens_per_batch: int, tokens: float, hidden_dim: int) -> float:
134        """adam_lr = lr_coeff * tokens^lr_tokens_exp * dim^lr_dim_exp * sqrt(tokens_per_batch)"""
135        adam_lr = (
136            self.lr_coeff * (tokens**self.lr_tokens_exp) * (hidden_dim**self.lr_dim_exp) * math.sqrt(tokens_per_batch)
137        )
138        return min(self.max_learning_rate, adam_lr)
139 
140    def _compute_learning_rate(self, tokens_per_batch: int, tokens: float, hidden_dim: int) -> float:
141        """muonh_lr = muonh_ratio * adam_lr"""
142        adam_lr = self._compute_adam_lr(tokens_per_batch, tokens, hidden_dim)
143        return min(self.max_learning_rate, self.muonh_ratio * adam_lr)
144 
145    def _compute_epsilon(self, tokens_per_batch: int, tokens: float) -> float:
146        """epsilon = epsilon_coeff * sqrt(tokens / tokens_per_batch)"""
147        return self.epsilon_coeff * math.sqrt(tokens / tokens_per_batch)
148 
149    def _compute_beta2(self, tokens_per_batch: int) -> float:
150        """beta2 = clip(beta2_0^(tpb/tpb0), min_beta2, max_beta2). Constant token half-life."""
151        exponent = tokens_per_batch / self.beta2_reference_tpb
152        return max(self.min_beta2, min(self.max_beta2, self.beta2_base**exponent))
153 
154    def build_optimizer_config(
155        self, batch_size: int, tokens: float, hidden_dim: int, seq_len: int = SEQ_LEN
156    ) -> GrugMoeMuonHConfig:
157        """Return a ``GrugMoeMuonHConfig`` with May Recipe 1pct-noclip defaults.
158 
159        MuonH optimizer (3 LR groups — muonh / adamh / adam) with
160        ``warmup=0.01`` and ``max_grad_norm=None``. LR / beta / epsilon
161        scaling is the May Recipe refit (see module docstring).
162        """
163        tokens_per_batch = batch_size * seq_len
164        lr = self._compute_learning_rate(tokens_per_batch, tokens, hidden_dim)
165        adam_lr = self._compute_adam_lr(tokens_per_batch, tokens, hidden_dim)
166        epsilon = self._compute_epsilon(tokens_per_batch, tokens)
167        beta2 = self._compute_beta2(tokens_per_batch)
168        return GrugMoeMuonHConfig(
169            learning_rate=lr,
170            adam_lr=adam_lr,
171            min_lr_ratio=self.min_lr_ratio,
172            warmup=0.01,  # 1pct-noclip schedule
173            beta1=self.beta1,
174            beta2=beta2,
175            epsilon=epsilon,
176            max_grad_norm=None,  # no clipping
177            lr_schedule=self.lr_schedule,
178            decay=self.decay,
179        )
180 
181    def _compute_num_layers(self, hidden_size: int) -> int:
182        hs_pow = math.log2(hidden_size)
183        return round(
184            hidden_size
185            / (self.base_hidden_layer_ratio + (hs_pow * self.layer_scaling_factor) - self.layer_formula_offset)
186        )
187 
188    def _get_step_size(self, budget: float) -> int:
189        if budget > self.budget_step_threshold:
190            return self.large_budget_step_size
191        return self.small_budget_step_size
192 
193    def _max_params_for_budget(self, budget: float) -> float:
194        scaling = self.base_max_params * math.sqrt(budget / self.base_max_params_budget)
195        return min(max(self.base_max_params, scaling), self.global_max_params)
196 
197    @staticmethod
198    def _compute_kv_heads(num_heads: int, gqa_ratio: int | None) -> int:
199        """Compute num_kv_heads for a given GQA ratio.
200 
201        If gqa_ratio is None, returns num_heads (MHA).
202        Otherwise returns the largest divisor of num_heads <= num_heads // gqa_ratio.
203        """
204        if gqa_ratio is None:
205            return num_heads
206        target = num_heads // gqa_ratio
207        for k in range(target, 0, -1):
208            if num_heads % k == 0:
209                return k
210        return 1
211 
212    def build_model_config(self, hidden_size: int, seq_len: int = SEQ_LEN) -> GrugModelConfig:
213        if hidden_size % self.hidden_head_ratio != 0:
214            raise ValueError(
215                f"hidden_size ({hidden_size}) must be divisible by hidden_head_ratio ({self.hidden_head_ratio})."
216            )
217        num_layers = self._compute_num_layers(hidden_size)
218        num_heads = max(1, hidden_size // self.hidden_head_ratio)
219        num_kv_heads = self._compute_kv_heads(num_heads, self.gqa_ratio)
220 
221        return GrugModelConfig(
222            vocab_size=self.vocab_size,
223            hidden_dim=hidden_size,
224            # Round up to nearest 128 for Pallas TPU MoE kernel compatibility
225            intermediate_dim=math.ceil(hidden_size / 2 / 128) * 128,
226            shared_expert_intermediate_dim=hidden_size,
227            num_layers=num_layers,
228            num_heads=num_heads,
229            num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
230            max_seq_len=seq_len,
231            sliding_window=2048,
232            initializer_std=0.5 / math.sqrt(hidden_size),
233            qk_mult=1.3,
234        )
235 
236 
237def build_from_heuristic(
238    *,
239    budget: float,
240    hidden_dim: int,
241    heuristic: MoeHeuristic | None = None,
242    target_steps: int = DEFAULT_TARGET_STEPS,
243    min_batch_size: int = MIN_BATCH_SIZE,
244    seq_len: int = SEQ_LEN,
245) -> tuple[GrugModelConfig, GrugMoeMuonHConfig, int, int]:
246    """Construct (model, optimizer, batch_size, num_steps) for a compute budget.
247 
248    Uses ``MoeHeuristic`` to size the model (from ``hidden_dim``) and to set
249    the MuonH hyperparameters (scaled by tokens_per_batch = batch_size * seq_len).
250    Callers who want manual control should continue passing ``GrugModelConfig`` /
251    ``GrugMoeMuonHConfig`` directly to ``GrugMoeLaunchConfig``.
252    """
253    h = heuristic or MoeHeuristic()
254    model_cfg = h.build_model_config(hidden_dim, seq_len=seq_len)
255    fpt = compute_flops_per_token(model_cfg)
256    tokens, batch_size, num_steps = compute_tokens_and_batch(
257        budget,
258        fpt,
259        target_steps=target_steps,
260        min_batch_size=min_batch_size,
261        seq_len=seq_len,
262    )
263    optimizer_cfg = h.build_optimizer_config(batch_size, tokens, hidden_dim, seq_len=seq_len)
264    return model_cfg, optimizer_cfg, batch_size, num_steps

4"""Large sparse-MoE scale run for the CoreWeave cw-us-east-02a H100 cluster.
5 
6Launches a ~90B-total / ~5B-active Grug MoE (hidden 3072, 48 layers, 128 experts,
7top-4 -> ~17x sparsity) across all 32 nodes / 256 H100s. Parameters are fully
8sharded over the cross-node ``data`` axis (FSDP) while the 128 routed experts are
9sharded 8-way over the intra-node NVLink ``expert`` axis (expert parallelism).
10 
11This is the size class the cluster can train as a *single* model. The canary
12(``experiments/ferries/canary_ferry.py``) replicates parameters per node, so it
13caps at the ~9.5B that fits on one node's 8 GPUs; here ``replica_axis_size=1``
14shards one model across every device instead.
15 
16Env knobs (all optional; defaults give the full 90B run on 256 H100):
17 
18    SCALE_GPU_REPLICAS  number of 8xH100 nodes (default 32 -> 256 GPUs)
19    SCALE_EXPERT_AXIS   expert-parallel axis size, intra-node (default 8)
20    SCALE_REPLICA_AXIS  cross-node replication; 1 = pure FSDP (default 1)
21    SCALE_PROCESSES_PER_TASK  GPU processes per node: 1 = one process per node
22                          (default), 8 = one JAX process per GPU (multi-controller)
23    SCALE_BATCH         global batch in sequences (default 256)
24    SCALE_SEQ_LEN       sequence length (default 2048)
25    SCALE_STEPS         training steps (default 50)
26    SCALE_HIDDEN_DIM / SCALE_NUM_LAYERS / SCALE_NUM_EXPERTS / SCALE_TOP_K
27                        model-shape overrides (e.g. a smaller FSDP smoke test)
28    SCALE_REMAT         recompute_all (default) | save_moe -- save_moe keeps the
29                        tagged MoE dispatch tensors for backward so the EP
30                        collectives are not re-run during recompute
31    SCALE_MP            jmp policy (default params=float32,compute=bfloat16,
32                        output=bfloat16); params=bfloat16 halves FSDP gather bytes
33    SCALE_TRACKER       wandb | json_logger (default json_logger)
34    SCALE_PROFILER_STEPS  >0 enables a jax_profile capture window of N steps
35                          (use SCALE_TRACKER=wandb so the artifact uploads)
36    SCALE_PROFILER_START  profiler start step (default 8, past compile/warmup)
37    SCALE_CHECKPOINTS   s3 (default) | local. local writes checkpoints to
38                        node-local disk with no periodic saves -- for throughput
39                        experiments where the checkpoint is disposable and a
40                        slow S3 commit must not wedge the end-of-run barrier
41    RUN_ID              unique run identifier
42"""
43

72# through a fully-replicated intermediate (an XLA SPMD limitation, pending Shardy),
73# so peak memory scales with batch*seq; at the default 89.7B model, batch 256 x

81SCALE_OPTIMIZER = AdamConfig(

99def build_scale_model() -> GrugModelConfig:
100    """~90B-total / ~5B-active sparse MoE (overridable via SCALE_* env vars)."""
101    hidden_dim = env_int("SCALE_HIDDEN_DIM", 3072)
102    if hidden_dim % HEAD_DIM != 0:
103        raise ValueError(f"SCALE_HIDDEN_DIM={hidden_dim} must be a multiple of head_dim={HEAD_DIM}")
104    num_heads = hidden_dim // HEAD_DIM
105    # ~4:1 grouped-query attention; back off to the nearest divisor of num_heads.
106    num_kv_heads = max(1, num_heads // 4)
107    while num_heads % num_kv_heads != 0:
108        num_kv_heads -= 1
109    intermediate_dim = hidden_dim // 2  # expert FFN inner width (~d/2)
110    seq_len = env_int("SCALE_SEQ_LEN", DEFAULT_SEQ_LEN)
111    remat_mode = os.environ.get("SCALE_REMAT", "recompute_all")
112    if remat_mode not in ("recompute_all", "save_moe"):
113        raise ValueError(f"SCALE_REMAT={remat_mode!r} must be 'recompute_all' or 'save_moe'")
114    return GrugModelConfig(
115        vocab_size=VOCAB_SIZE,
116        hidden_dim=hidden_dim,
117        num_layers=env_int("SCALE_NUM_LAYERS", 48),
118        num_heads=num_heads,
119        num_kv_heads=num_kv_heads,
120        head_dim=HEAD_DIM,
121        intermediate_dim=intermediate_dim,
122        shared_expert_intermediate_dim=intermediate_dim,
123        num_experts=env_int("SCALE_NUM_EXPERTS", 128),
124        num_experts_per_token=env_int("SCALE_TOP_K", 4),
125        max_seq_len=seq_len,
126        sliding_window=seq_len,
127        remat_mode=cast(RematMode, remat_mode),
128    )
129

131def build_scale_checkpoint(*, version: str | None = None) -> ArtifactStep[LevanterCheckpoint]:
132    """Assemble the CoreWeave scale run as a lazy :class:`LevanterCheckpoint` from SCALE_* env."""
133    run_id = os.environ.get("RUN_ID") or datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")
134 
135    replicas = env_int("SCALE_GPU_REPLICAS", 32)
136    expert_axis = env_int("SCALE_EXPERT_AXIS", 8)
137    replica_axis = env_int("SCALE_REPLICA_AXIS", 1)
138    batch_size = env_int("SCALE_BATCH", DEFAULT_BATCH)
139    steps = env_int("SCALE_STEPS", 50)
140    # 1 = one process per node (8 local GPUs). 8 = one JAX process per GPU
141    # (multi-controller) via the iris.hooks.multigpu_main supervisor.
142    processes_per_task = env_int("SCALE_PROCESSES_PER_TASK", 1)
143    # SCALE_PROFILER_STEPS > 0 captures a jax_profile window of that many steps
144    # (uploaded via the tracker, so pair with SCALE_TRACKER=wandb to retrieve it).
145    profiler_steps = env_int("SCALE_PROFILER_STEPS", 0)
146    profiler = ProfilerConfig(
147        enabled=profiler_steps > 0,
148        start_step=env_int("SCALE_PROFILER_START", 8),
149        num_steps=profiler_steps,
150    )
151 
152    checkpoint_mode = os.environ.get("SCALE_CHECKPOINTS", "s3").lower()
153    if checkpoint_mode == "local":
154        checkpointer = CheckpointerConfig(
155            base_path=f"/tmp/grug-scale-ckpt/{run_id}",
156            append_run_id_to_base_path=False,
157            save_interval=None,
158            keep=None,
159        )
160    elif checkpoint_mode == "s3":
161        checkpointer = None
162    else:
163        raise ValueError(f"SCALE_CHECKPOINTS={checkpoint_mode!r} must be 's3' or 'local'")
164 
165    model = build_scale_model()
166    if model.num_experts % expert_axis != 0:
167        raise ValueError(f"num_experts={model.num_experts} must be divisible by SCALE_EXPERT_AXIS={expert_axis}")
168 
169    # Batch is sharded over the (replica_dcn, data, expert) axes; data absorbs the
170    # rest of the 8*replicas devices. Require the global batch to cover every shard.
171    data_axis = (replicas * GPUS_PER_NODE) // (replica_axis * expert_axis)
172    batch_shards = replica_axis * data_axis * expert_axis
173    if batch_size % batch_shards != 0:
174        raise ValueError(f"SCALE_BATCH={batch_size} must be divisible by batch shards={batch_shards}")
175 
176    resources = ResourceConfig.with_gpu("H100", count=GPUS_PER_NODE, cpu=32, ram="256g", disk="256g", replicas=replicas)
177 
178    use_wandb = os.environ.get("SCALE_TRACKER", "json_logger").lower() == "wandb"
179    json_logger_name = os.environ.get("SCALE_JSON_LOGGER", "grug_moe_scale.metrics")
180    wandb_entity = os.environ.get("WANDB_ENTITY") or None
181    wandb_project = os.environ.get("WANDB_PROJECT", "marin_moe")
182 
183    grug_trainer = GrugTrainerConfig(
184        expert_axis_size=expert_axis,
185        replica_axis_size=replica_axis,
186        **SCALE_TRAINER_DEFAULTS,
187    )
188 
189    mp = os.environ.get("SCALE_MP", "params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16")
190    name = f"grug-moe-cw-d{model.hidden_dim}-L{model.num_layers}-e{model.num_experts}-r{replicas}"
191    slim = slimpajama_6b_dataset()
192 
193    def build_config(ctx: StepContext) -> GrugMoeLaunchConfig:
194        if use_wandb:
195            tracker = WandbConfig(
196                entity=wandb_entity,
197                project=wandb_project,
198                tags=["grug", "moe", "cw", "h100", "scale"],
199                group="grug-moe-cw-scale",
200                name=None,
201                replicate_path=ctx.output_path,
202            )
203        else:

205        return GrugMoeLaunchConfig(

210            resources=ctx.runtime_arg("train_resources"),
211            steps=steps,

213            seed=0,

215            tracker=tracker,
216            optimizer=SCALE_OPTIMIZER,
217            grug_trainer=grug_trainer,
218            processes_per_task=processes_per_task,
219            eval=None,

221            checkpointer=checkpointer,
222        )

252def _bucket_path(bucket: str) -> str:
253    cluster = int(bucket[1:3])
254    quality = int(bucket[-1])
255    return f"{_STORE_PREFIX}/cluster={cluster}/quality={quality}"
256 
257 
258def _bucket_component(bucket: str) -> DatasetComponent:
259    return DatasetComponent(
260        source=None,
261        cache_dir=_bucket_path(bucket),
262        format=TextLmDatasetFormat(),
263        tags=[bucket],
264        flat_cache=True,
265    )
266 
267 
268def _val_component(cache_dir: str) -> DatasetComponent:
269    """Placeholder validation component from a cache dir path."""
270    source = UrlDatasetSourceConfig(
271        tags=[],
272        train_urls=[],
273        validation_urls=[],
274        cache_dir=cache_dir,
275        format=TextLmDatasetFormat(),
276    )
277    return DatasetComponent(source=source, cache_dir=source.cache_dir, format=source.format, tags=source.tags)
278 
279 
280def _normalize(weights: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, float]:
281    total = sum(weights.values())
282    if total <= 0:
283        raise ValueError("mixture weights must sum to a positive value")
284    return {name: weight / total for name, weight in weights.items() if weight > 0}
285 
286 
287def _phase_weights(phase_index: int) -> dict[str, float]:
288    if phase_index == 0:
289        return _normalize({bucket: phase_0 for bucket, phase_0, _ in _BUCKET_PHASE_WEIGHTS})
290    if phase_index == 1:
291        return _normalize({bucket: phase_1 for bucket, _, phase_1 in _BUCKET_PHASE_WEIGHTS})
292    raise ValueError(f"unknown phase index {phase_index}")
293 
294 
295def _phase_1_start_step(total_steps: int, batch_size: int) -> int:
296    requested = max(1, int(total_steps * _PHASE_1_START_FRACTION))
297    step_multiple = _MIXTURE_BLOCK_SIZE // math.gcd(_MIXTURE_BLOCK_SIZE, batch_size)
298    return max(step_multiple, (requested // step_multiple) * step_multiple)
299 
300 
301def _datakit_components() -> dict[str, DatasetComponent | ConcatDatasetComponent]:
302    direct = {bucket: _bucket_component(bucket) for bucket, _, _ in _BUCKET_PHASE_WEIGHTS if bucket != "tail"}
303    return {
304        **direct,
305        "tail": ConcatDatasetComponent(
306            children={bucket: _bucket_component(bucket) for bucket in _TAIL_BUCKETS},
307            tags=["tail"],
308        ),
309    }
310 
311 
312def _simulated_experiment_budget(*, total_steps: int, batch_size: int, max_seq_len: int) -> int:
313    return total_steps * batch_size * max_seq_len
314 
315 
316def _simulated_epoching_budgets(
317    *,
318    total_steps: int,
319    batch_size: int,
320    max_seq_len: int,
321    target_budget: int,
322    enable_simulated_epoching: bool,
323) -> tuple[int | None, int | None]:
324    if not enable_simulated_epoching:
325        return None, None
326    experiment_budget = _simulated_experiment_budget(
327        total_steps=total_steps,
328        batch_size=batch_size,
329        max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
330    )
331    if experiment_budget > target_budget:
332        raise ValueError(f"experiment_budget {experiment_budget} exceeds target_budget {target_budget}")
333    return target_budget, experiment_budget
334 
335 
336def _two_phase_data_config(
337    *,
338    tokenizer: str,
339    components: dict[str, DatasetComponent | ConcatDatasetComponent],
340    phase_weights: tuple[dict[str, float], dict[str, float]],
341    phase_1_start: int,
342    val_components: dict[str, DatasetComponent | ConcatDatasetComponent],
343    target_budget: int | None,
344    experiment_budget: int | None,
345) -> LmDataConfig:
346    val_zero_weights = {name: 0.0 for name in val_components}
347    budget_kwargs = {}
348    if target_budget is not None:
349        budget_kwargs = {"target_budget": target_budget, "experiment_budget": experiment_budget}
350 
351    return LmDataConfig(
352        tokenizer=tokenizer,
353        cache_dir=None,
354        components={**components, **val_components},
355        train_weights=[
356            (0, {**phase_weights[0], **val_zero_weights}),
357            (phase_1_start, {**phase_weights[1], **val_zero_weights}),
358        ],
359        auto_build_caches=False,
360        mixture_block_size=_MIXTURE_BLOCK_SIZE,
361        **budget_kwargs,
362    )
363 
364 
365def _datakit_data_config(
366    *,
367    total_steps: int,
368    batch_size: int,
369    max_seq_len: int,
370    enable_simulated_epoching: bool,
371    val_components: dict[str, DatasetComponent | ConcatDatasetComponent],
372) -> LmDataConfig:
373    phase_1_start = _phase_1_start_step(total_steps, batch_size)
374    target_budget, experiment_budget = _simulated_epoching_budgets(
375        total_steps=total_steps,
376        batch_size=batch_size,
377        max_seq_len=max_seq_len,
378        target_budget=_TARGET_BUDGET_TOKENS,
379        enable_simulated_epoching=enable_simulated_epoching,
380    )
381 
382    return _two_phase_data_config(
383        tokenizer=marin_tokenizer,
384        components=_datakit_components(),
385        phase_weights=(_phase_weights(0), _phase_weights(1)),
386        phase_1_start=phase_1_start,
387        val_components=val_components,
388        target_budget=target_budget,
389        experiment_budget=experiment_budget,
390    )
391 
392 
393_BUDGET: float = 2.19e17
394_HIDDEN_DIM: int = 512
395_TARGET_STEPS: int = 2**14
396_model, _optimizer, _batch_size, _steps = build_from_heuristic(
397    budget=_BUDGET,
398    hidden_dim=_HIDDEN_DIM,
399    target_steps=_TARGET_STEPS,
400)
401 
402_SLUG = f"d{_HIDDEN_DIM}-{_BUDGET:.2e}"
403 
404_VALIDATION = [
405    *paloma_datasets(tokenizer=marin_tokenizer).values(),
406    *uncheatable_datasets(tokenizer=marin_tokenizer).values(),
407]
408 
409 
410def build(*, version: str | None = None) -> ArtifactStep[LevanterCheckpoint]:
411    """Grug MoE on the us-central2 datakit store with the mixture-3 two-phase bucket schedule."""
412    name = f"grug/datakit_moe_mix_{_SLUG}"
413    version = resolve_version(name, version)
414 
415    def build_config(ctx: StepContext) -> GrugMoeLaunchConfig:
416        if ctx.is_fingerprint:
417            val_components = {v.name: _val_component(ctx.artifact_path(v)) for v in _VALIDATION}
418        else:
419            val_components = {v.name: ctx.resolved(v).as_component() for v in _VALIDATION}
420        data = _datakit_data_config(
421            total_steps=_steps,
422            batch_size=_batch_size,
423            max_seq_len=_model.max_seq_len,
424            enable_simulated_epoching=ENABLE_SIMULATED_EPOCHING,
425            val_components=val_components,
426        )
427        return GrugMoeLaunchConfig(
428            model=_model,
429            data=data,
430            output_path=ctx.output_path,
431            run_id="datakit-moe-mix",
432            resources=ctx.runtime_arg("train_resources"),
433            steps=_steps,
434            batch_size=_batch_size,
435            seed=0,
436            mp="params=float32,compute=bfloat16,output=bfloat16",
437            tracker=WandbConfig(
438                project="marin_moe",
439                tags=["moe", "datakit_store_mix", _SLUG],
440                group="datakit-moe-mix",
441                name=None,
442            ),
443            optimizer=_optimizer,
