17def _target_named_sharding(array) -> jax.sharding.NamedSharding | None:
18    if array is None or not hasattr(array, "shape"):
19        return None
20    sharding = getattr(array, "sharding", None)
21    if sharding is None:
22        aval = jax.typeof(array)
23        sharding = getattr(aval, "sharding", None)
24    if isinstance(sharding, jax.sharding.NamedSharding):
25        return sharding
26    return None
27 
28 
29def _match_named_update_sharding() -> optax.GradientTransformation:
30    """Restore named mesh sharding without touching single-device arrays."""
31 
32    def init_fn(params):
33        del params
34        return optax.EmptyState()
35 
36    def update_fn(updates, state, params=None):
37        if params is None:
38            return updates, state
39 
40        def match_sharding(update, param):
41            if update is None:
42                return None
43            target_sharding = _target_named_sharding(param)
44            if target_sharding is None:
45                return update
46            return jax.sharding.reshard(update, target_sharding)
47 
48        updates = jax.tree.map(match_sharding, updates, params, is_leaf=lambda x: x is None)
49        return updates, state
50 
51    return optax.GradientTransformation(init_fn, update_fn)

54def _match_named_sharding_to_params(updates, params):
55    def match_sharding(update, param):
56        if update is None:
57            return None
58        target_sharding = _target_named_sharding(param)
59        if target_sharding is None:
60            return update
61        return jax.sharding.reshard(update, target_sharding)
62 
63    return jax.tree.map(match_sharding, updates, params, is_leaf=lambda x: x is None)

66def _scale_invariant_hyperball_updates(params, direction_updates, learning_rate: float):
67    direction_updates = _match_named_sharding_to_params(direction_updates, params)
68 
69    def scale_invariant_update(param, update):
70        if update is None:
71            return None
72        if not hasattr(param, "ndim"):
73            return update
74        if param.ndim == 2:
75            param_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(param)
76            update_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(update)
77            new_param = param - learning_rate * update * param_norm / jnp.maximum(update_norm, 1e-10)
78            new_param_norm = jnp.linalg.norm(new_param)
79            return new_param / jnp.maximum(new_param_norm, 1e-10) * param_norm - param
80 
81        axes = tuple(range(1, param.ndim))
82        param_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum(jnp.square(param), axis=axes, keepdims=True))
83        update_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum(jnp.square(update), axis=axes, keepdims=True))
84        new_param = param - learning_rate * update * param_norm / jnp.maximum(update_norm, 1e-10)
85        new_param_norm = jnp.sqrt(jnp.sum(jnp.square(new_param), axis=axes, keepdims=True))
86        return new_param / jnp.maximum(new_param_norm, 1e-10) * param_norm - param
87 
88    return jax.tree.map(
89        scale_invariant_update,
90        params,
91        direction_updates,
92        is_leaf=lambda x: x is None,
93    )
94

96def scale_with_grug_muonh(
97    momentum: float = 0.95,
98    nesterov: bool = True,
99    steps: int = 5,
100    muon_eps: float = 1e-8,
101    learning_rate: float = 0.02,
102    coefficient_type: CoefficientType = "quintic",
103) -> optax.GradientTransformation:
104    """MuonH transform for raw Grug arrays with matrix-shaped trailing dims."""
105    muon_transform = _grug_scale_with_muon(
106        momentum=momentum,
107        nesterov=nesterov,
108        steps=steps,
109        muon_eps=muon_eps,
110        use_kimi_scaling=False,
111        coefficient_type=coefficient_type,
112    )
113 
114    def init_fn(params):
115        return muon_transform.init(params)
116 
117    def update_fn(updates, state, params=None):
118        if params is None:
119            raise ValueError("scale_with_grug_muonh requires params for norm-preserving updates")
120 
121        muon_updates, next_state = muon_transform.update(updates, state, params)
122        muonh_updates = _scale_invariant_hyperball_updates(params, muon_updates, learning_rate)
123        return muonh_updates, next_state
124 
125    return optax.GradientTransformation(init_fn, update_fn)

128@OptimizerConfig.register_subclass("grug_moe_adamh_v2")
129@dataclass(frozen=True)
130class GrugMoeAdamHConfig(OptimizerConfig):
131    """AdamH for Grug MoE. Four optimizer groups, no flags.
132 
133    - adamh: attention weights, dense MLP weights (2D matrices)
134    - adamh_expert: expert MLP weights (mlp.expert_mlp.w_gate,
135      mlp.expert_mlp.w_up, mlp.expert_mlp.w_down, shared.w_*)
136    - adam: norms, biases, router, embeddings, attention gates (1D / small params)
137    """
138 
139    beta1: float = 0.9
140    beta2: float = 0.95
141    epsilon: float = 1e-8
142    max_grad_norm: float | None = 1.0
143    adam_lr: float = 6e-4
144    expert_lr: float | None = None
145 
146    def build(self, num_train_steps):
147        learning_rate_schedule = self.lr_scheduler(num_train_steps)
148        adam_lr_schedule = self.lr_scheduler(num_train_steps, override_lr=self.adam_lr)
149        expert_lr_val = self.expert_lr if self.expert_lr is not None else self.learning_rate
150        expert_lr_schedule = self.lr_scheduler(num_train_steps, override_lr=expert_lr_val)
151 
152        def optimizer(learning_rate, adam_lr, expert_lr):
153            def adamh_transform():
154                components = []
155                if self.max_grad_norm:
156                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
157                components.append(scale_by_adamh(self.beta1, self.beta2, self.epsilon, learning_rate))
158                return optax.chain(*components)
159 
160            def adamh_expert_transform():
161                components = []
162                if self.max_grad_norm:
163                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
164                components.append(scale_by_adamh(self.beta1, self.beta2, self.epsilon, expert_lr))
165                return optax.chain(*components)
166 
167            def adam_transform():
168                components = []
169                if self.max_grad_norm:
170                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
171                components.append(optax.scale_by_adam(self.beta1, self.beta2, self.epsilon))
172                components.append(optax.scale(-adam_lr))
173                return optax.chain(*components)
174 
175            return optax.multi_transform(
176                {
177                    "adamh": adamh_transform(),
178                    "adamh_expert": adamh_expert_transform(),
179                    "adam": adam_transform(),
180                },
181                self.create_mask,
182            )
183 
184        return optax.inject_hyperparams(optimizer)(
185            learning_rate=learning_rate_schedule,
186            adam_lr=adam_lr_schedule,
187            expert_lr=expert_lr_schedule,
188        )
189 
190    def create_mask(self, params):
191        paths = leaf_key_paths(params)
192 
193        def mask_fn(param, path):
194            path_str = ".".join(path) if isinstance(path, (list, tuple)) else str(path)
195            path_lower = path_str.lower()
196            if "token_embed" in path_lower:
197                return "adam"
198            if "router_bias" in path_lower or "attn_gate" in path_lower or ".router" in path_lower:
199                return "adam"
200            if ".mlp.expert_mlp.w_" in path_lower or ".mlp.w_" in path_lower or ".shared.w_" in path_lower:
201                return "adamh_expert"
202            if hasattr(param, "ndim") and param.ndim >= 2:
203                return "adamh"
204            return "adam"
205 
206        return jax.tree.map(mask_fn, params, paths)

209@OptimizerConfig.register_subclass("grug_moe_muonh_v1")
210@dataclass(frozen=True)
211class GrugMoeMuonHConfig(OptimizerConfig):
212    """May Recipe MuonH optimizer: 3 LR groups (muonh / adamh / adam).
213 
214    Three LR groups:
215    - ``muonh``: matrices (attn, MoE MLP, shared) **and** all GatedNorms.
216      Newton-Schulz orthogonalisation + Frobenius hyperball scale-invariant step.
217    - ``adamh``: ``lm_head`` / ``output_proj``.
218    - ``adam``: ``token_embed`` / ``router`` / ``router_bias`` / ``attn_gate``
219      / 1-D norm weights.
220 
221    ``max_grad_norm`` defaults to ``None`` here (no clipping) for the 1pct-noclip
222    schedule used by the May Recipe baseline.
223    """
224 
225    adam_lr: float = 6e-4
226    momentum: float = 0.95
227    nesterov: bool = True
228    backend_steps: int = 5
229    beta1: float = 0.9
230    beta2: float = 0.95
231    epsilon: float = 1e-8
232    muon_epsilon: float = 1e-8
233    max_grad_norm: float | None = None
234    coefficient_type: CoefficientType = "quintic"
235 
236    def build(self, num_train_steps):
237        learning_rate_schedule = self.lr_scheduler(num_train_steps)
238        adam_lr_schedule = self.lr_scheduler(num_train_steps, override_lr=self.adam_lr)
239 
240        def optimizer(learning_rate, adam_lr):
241            def muonh_transform():
242                components = []
243                if self.max_grad_norm:
244                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
245                components.append(
246                    scale_with_grug_muonh(
247                        momentum=self.momentum,
248                        nesterov=self.nesterov,
249                        steps=self.backend_steps,
250                        muon_eps=self.muon_epsilon,
251                        learning_rate=learning_rate,
252                        coefficient_type=self.coefficient_type,
253                    )
254                )
255                components.append(_match_named_update_sharding())
256                return optax.chain(*components)
257 
258            def adamh_transform_at(lr):
259                components = []
260                if self.max_grad_norm:
261                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
262                components.append(scale_by_adamh(self.beta1, self.beta2, self.epsilon, lr))
263                return optax.chain(*components)
264 
265            def adam_transform_at(lr):
266                components = []
267                if self.max_grad_norm:
268                    components.append(optax.clip_by_global_norm(self.max_grad_norm))
269                components.append(optax.scale_by_adam(self.beta1, self.beta2, self.epsilon))
270                components.append(optax.scale(-lr))
271                return optax.chain(*components)
272 
273            transforms = {
274                "muonh": muonh_transform(),
275                "adamh": adamh_transform_at(learning_rate),
276                "adam": adam_transform_at(adam_lr),
277            }
278            return optax.multi_transform(transforms, self.create_mask)
279 
280        return optax.inject_hyperparams(optimizer)(
281            learning_rate=learning_rate_schedule,
282            adam_lr=adam_lr_schedule,
283        )
284 
285    def create_mask(self, params):
286        paths = leaf_key_paths(params)
287 
288        def mask_fn(param, path):
289            path_str = ".".join(path) if isinstance(path, (list, tuple)) else str(path)
290            path_lower = path_str.lower()
291            if (
292                "token_embed" in path_lower
293                or "router_bias" in path_lower
294                or path_lower.endswith(".attn_gate")
295                or ".router" in path_lower
296            ):
297                return "adam"
298            if "output_proj" in path_lower or "lm_head" in path_lower:
299                return "adamh"
300            # GatedNorms route to muonh (NS + Frobenius hyperball), same as matrices.
301            if "gated_norm" in path_lower:
302                return "muonh"
303            if hasattr(param, "ndim") and param.ndim in (2, 3):
304                return "muonh"
305            return "adam"
306 
307        return jax.tree.map(mask_fn, params, paths)

87    shuffle: bool = True  # Mix eval domains within batches to reduce expert-capacity drops.
88

90@dataclass(frozen=True)
91class GrugRunConfig:
92    """Top-level config for grug training."""
93 
94    model: GrugModelConfig
95    data: LmDataConfig
96    resources: ResourceConfig
97    optimizer: OptimizerConfig = field(default_factory=AdamConfig)
98    trainer: GrugTrainerConfig = field(default_factory=GrugTrainerConfig)
99    eval: GrugEvalConfig | None = field(default_factory=GrugEvalConfig)
100    # GPU processes per task: > 1 runs one JAX process per GPU (multi-controller)
101    # via the iris.hooks.multigpu_main supervisor instead of one process per node.
102    processes_per_task: int = 1

105def build_train_dataset(
106    data_config: LmDataConfig,
107    *,
108    max_seq_len: int,
109    batch_schedule: BatchSchedule,
110    key: PRNGKeyArray,
111) -> MixtureDataset[GrugLmExample]:
112    pos = Axis("position", max_seq_len)
113    mix_key, shuffle_key = jax.random.split(key)
114    weights = data_config.train_weights
115    if isinstance(weights, list):
116        weights = rescale_mixture_schedule_for_batch_schedule(weights, batch_schedule)
117 
118    initial_batch_size = batch_schedule.batch_size_at_step(0)
119    datasets = data_config.train_sets(pos, key=shuffle_key, initial_batch_size=initial_batch_size)
120    return MixtureDataset(
121        datasets=datasets,
122        weights=weights,
123        stop_strategy=data_config.stop_strategy,
124        key=mix_key,
125        block_size=data_config.mixture_block_size,
126    )
127

129def build_train_loader(
130    dataset: AsyncDataset[GrugLmExample],
131    *,
132    batch_schedule: BatchSchedule,
133    mesh: Mesh,
134) -> DataLoader[GrugLmExample]:
135    # DataLoader uses this batch axis mapping to shard batches across the distributed mesh.
136    # `compact_grug_mesh` always carries (replica_dcn, data, expert, model); length-1 axes
137    # are kept so we can name "expert" unconditionally.
138    return DataLoader(
139        dataset,
140        batch_schedule.schedule,
141        mesh=mesh,
142        axis_resources={"__BATCH__": BATCH_AXES},
143        batch_axis_name="__BATCH__",
144        allow_nondivisible_batch_size=False,
145    )
146 
147 
148def build_tagged_evaluator(
149    *,
150    data_config: LmDataConfig,
151    max_seq_len: int,
152    mesh: Mesh,
153    eval_cfg: GrugEvalConfig,
154) -> TaggedEvaluator[LmExample | GrugLmExample, Transformer] | None:
155    pos = Axis("position", max_seq_len)
156    tagged_eval_sets = data_config.tagged_eval_sets(pos)
157    if len(tagged_eval_sets) == 0:
158        logger.warning("No evaluation datasets provided.")
159        return None
160 
161    max_examples_per_dataset = None
162    if eval_cfg.max_eval_batches is not None:
163        max_examples_per_dataset = eval_cfg.max_eval_batches * eval_cfg.eval_batch_size
164 
165    tokenizer = data_config.the_tokenizer if eval_cfg.compute_bpb else None
166    # `compact_grug_mesh` always carries (replica_dcn, data, expert, model); length-1 axes
167    # are kept so we can name "expert" unconditionally.
168    eval_axis_mapping = {"batch": BATCH_AXES}
169    eval_batch = Axis("batch", eval_cfg.eval_batch_size)
170    eval_array_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P(BATCH_AXES, None))
171 
172    def eval_loss_fn(model: Transformer, batch: LmExample | GrugLmExample) -> tuple[jax.Array, jax.Array, jax.Array]:
173        if isinstance(batch, LmExample):
174            batch = grug_lm_example_from_named(batch)
175        per_pos_loss = model.next_token_loss(
176            batch.tokens,
177            batch.loss_weight,
178            mask=batch.attn_mask,
179            reduction="none",
180            logsumexp_weight=None,
181        )
182        per_pos_loss = jax.sharding.reshard(per_pos_loss, eval_array_sharding)
183        per_pos_weight = jax.sharding.reshard(batch.loss_weight, eval_array_sharding)
184        per_pos_token_id = jnp.pad(batch.tokens[:, 1:], ((0, 0), (0, 1)))
185        return per_pos_loss, per_pos_weight, per_pos_token_id
186 
187    return TaggedEvaluator(
188        EvalBatch=eval_batch,
189        tagged_eval_sets=tagged_eval_sets,
190        loss_fn=eval_loss_fn,
191        tokenizer=tokenizer,
192        device_mesh=mesh,
193        axis_mapping=eval_axis_mapping,
194        max_examples_per_dataset=max_examples_per_dataset,
195        shuffle=eval_cfg.shuffle,
196    )
197 
198 
199def _compute_flops(
200    *,
201    model_config: GrugModelConfig,
202) -> tuple[float, dict[str, float]]:
203    flops_per_token = lm_flops_per_token(
204        hidden_dim=model_config.hidden_dim,
205        intermediate_dim=model_config.intermediate_dim,
206        shared_intermediate_dim=model_config.shared_expert_intermediate_dim,
207        num_layers=model_config.num_layers,
208        num_kv_heads=model_config.num_kv_heads,
209        num_heads=model_config.num_heads,
210        seq_len=model_config.max_seq_len,
211        vocab_size=model_config.vocab_size,
212        glu=True,
213        num_experts=model_config.num_experts,
214        num_shared_experts=1 if model_config.shared_expert_intermediate_dim > 0 else 0,
215        num_experts_per_tok=model_config.num_experts_per_token,
216    )
217    flops_per_example = 3 * flops_per_token * model_config.max_seq_len
218 
219    flops_summary: dict[str, float] = {
220        "throughput/flops_per_token_analytic": flops_per_token,
221        "throughput/flops_per_example_analytic": flops_per_example,
222    }
223 
224    return flops_per_example, flops_summary
225

227def _make_mixture_stage_callback(train_dataset: MixtureDataset, batch_schedule: BatchSchedule):
228    last_mixture_stage = -1
229 
230    def log_mixture_stage(step_info):
231        nonlocal last_mixture_stage
232        seq_index = batch_schedule.global_data_offset_by_step(step_info.step)
233        block_id = seq_index // train_dataset.block_size
234        stage = train_dataset._get_stage_for_block(block_id)
235        if stage == last_mixture_stage:
236            return
237 
238        weights = train_dataset.weight_stages[stage][1]
239        mixture_log = {f"mixture/weight/{name}": weight for name, weight in weights.items()}
240        mixture_log["mixture/stage"] = stage
241        levanter.tracker.log(mixture_log, step=step_info.step)
242        last_mixture_stage = stage
243 
244    return log_mixture_stage
245

247@register_dataclass
248@dataclass(frozen=True)
249class GrugTrainState:
250    step: jax.Array
251    params: Transformer
252    opt_state: optax.OptState
253    ema_params: Transformer | None
254    pending_qb_betas: jax.Array
255 
256 
257def _apply_qb_betas(model: Transformer, qb_betas: jax.Array) -> Transformer:
258    """Set router biases from QB betas (computed on previous step)."""
259    new_blocks = list(model.blocks)
260    moe_idx = 0
261    for i, block in enumerate(model.blocks):
262        if block.mlp is None:
263            continue
264        new_bias = -qb_betas[moe_idx]
265        new_bias = new_bias - jnp.mean(new_bias)
266        new_mlp = eqx.tree_at(lambda m: m.router_bias, block.mlp, new_bias)
267        new_blocks[i] = eqx.tree_at(lambda b: b.mlp, block, new_mlp)
268        moe_idx += 1
269    return eqx.tree_at(lambda t: t.blocks, model, tuple(new_blocks))
270 
271 
272def initial_state(
273    model_config: GrugModelConfig,
274    *,
275    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
276    mp: jmp.Policy,
277    key: PRNGKeyArray,
278    ema_beta: float | None,
279) -> GrugTrainState:
280    params = mp.cast_to_param(Transformer.init(model_config, key=key))
281    num_moe_layers = sum(1 for b in params.blocks if b.mlp is not None)
282    return GrugTrainState(
283        step=jnp.array(0, dtype=jnp.int32),
284        params=params,
285        opt_state=optimizer.init(params),
286        ema_params=params if ema_beta is not None else None,
287        pending_qb_betas=jnp.zeros((num_moe_layers, model_config.num_experts)),
288    )
289 
290 
291def _make_train_step(
292    optimizer: optax.GradientTransformation,
293    mp: jmp.Policy,
294    *,
295    z_loss_weight: float,
296    ema_beta: float | None,
297    watch_config: WatchConfig | None = None,
298):
299    one = jnp.array(1, dtype=jnp.int32)
300    z_loss = z_loss_weight if z_loss_weight > 0 else None
301    if watch_config is not None:
302        if isinstance(watch_config.watch_targets, str):
303            watch_targets = tuple(t.strip() for t in watch_config.watch_targets.split(","))
304        else:
305            watch_targets = tuple(watch_config.watch_targets)
306    else:
307        watch_targets = ()
308 
309    @functools.partial(jax.jit, donate_argnums=(0,), static_argnames=("compute_watch",))
310    def train_step(state: GrugTrainState, batch, *, compute_watch: bool = False):
311        # Apply pending QB betas to router biases inside JIT (avoids eager
312        # host-side TPU kernel launches that can cause SPMD sync issues).
313        qb_params = _apply_qb_betas(state.params, state.pending_qb_betas)
314        if ema_beta is not None:
315            qb_ema_params = _apply_qb_betas(state.ema_params, state.pending_qb_betas)
316        else:
317            qb_ema_params = None
318 
319        def loss_fn(params):
320            compute_params = mp.cast_to_compute(params)
321            return compute_params.next_token_loss(
322                batch.tokens,
323                batch.loss_weight,
324                mask=batch.attn_mask,
325                reduction="mean",
326                logsumexp_weight=z_loss,
327                return_router_metrics=True,
328            )
329 
330        (loss, summarized_metrics), grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn, has_aux=True)(qb_params)
331        metrics = {"train/loss": loss, **summarized_metrics}
332        updates, opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, state.opt_state, qb_params)
333        params = optax.apply_updates(qb_params, updates)
334 
335        if ema_beta is None:
336            ema_params = None
337        else:
338            if qb_ema_params is None:
339                raise ValueError("ema_params must be initialized when ema_beta is set.")
340            ema_params = jax.tree_util.tree_map(
341                lambda old, new: ema_beta * old + (1.0 - ema_beta) * new,
342                qb_ema_params,
343                params,
344            )
345 
346        watch_stats = None
347        if watch_config is not None and compute_watch:
348            watch_stats = compute_watch_stats(
349                watch_targets=watch_targets,
350                include_norms=watch_config.include_norms,
351                include_per_parameter_norms=watch_config.include_per_parameter_norms,
352                include_histogram=watch_config.include_histograms,
353                split_scan_layers=watch_config.split_scan_layers,
354                params=qb_params,
355                grads=grads,
356                updates=updates,
357                opt_state=state.opt_state,
358                model_tree_type=type(state.params),
359            )
360 
361        next_state = dataclasses.replace(
362            state,
363            step=state.step + one,
364            params=params,
365            opt_state=opt_state,
366            ema_params=ema_params,
367            pending_qb_betas=metrics["qb_beta_per_layer"],
368        )
369 
370        return next_state, metrics, watch_stats
371 
372    return train_step
373 
374 
375def _run_grug_local(config: GrugRunConfig) -> None:
376    """Entry point for the grug template training loop."""
377    trainer = config.trainer.trainer
378    trainer.initialize()
379    levanter.tracker.log_configuration(config)
380 
381    run_id = trainer.id
382    if run_id is None:
383        raise ValueError("trainer.id was not initialized")
384 
385    optimizer = config.optimizer.build(trainer.num_train_steps)
386    watch_config = trainer.watch
387    train_step = _make_train_step(
388        optimizer,
389        trainer.mp,
390        z_loss_weight=config.trainer.z_loss_weight,
391        ema_beta=config.trainer.ema_beta,
392        watch_config=watch_config if watch_config.is_enabled else None,
393    )
394 
395    data_key, model_key = jax.random.split(jax.random.PRNGKey(trainer.seed), 2)
396    if config.trainer.data_seed is not None:
397        data_key = jax.random.PRNGKey(config.trainer.data_seed)
398 
399    # Grug uses raw PartitionSpecs rather than Trainer's logical axis mapping.
400    # Keep the mesh compact so the batch pspec derived by `_batch_spec(mesh)` spans slices directly.
401    # replica_axis_size=None lets compact_grug_mesh default to jax.process_count() (full
402    # cross-slice replication); set it to 1 on GrugTrainerConfig for cross-slice FSDP.
403    mesh = compact_grug_mesh(
404        expert_axis_size=config.trainer.expert_axis_size,
405        replica_axis_size=config.trainer.replica_axis_size,
406    )
407    checkpointer = trainer.checkpointer.create(run_id)
408    with set_mesh(mesh), TrainingDashboard(config, checkpointer.request_checkpoint, run_id):
409        batch_schedule = trainer.batch_schedule
410 
411        train_dataset = build_train_dataset(
412            config.data,
413            max_seq_len=config.model.max_seq_len,
414            batch_schedule=batch_schedule,
415            key=data_key,
416        )
417        train_loader = build_train_loader(
418            train_dataset,
419            batch_schedule=batch_schedule,
420            mesh=mesh,
421        )
422 
423        @jax.jit
424        def _init_state(model_rng):
425            return initial_state(
426                config.model,
427                optimizer=optimizer,
428                mp=trainer.mp,
429                key=model_rng,
430                ema_beta=config.trainer.ema_beta,
431            )
432 
433        state = _init_state(model_key)
434 
435        state = restore_grug_state_from_checkpoint(
436            state,
437            checkpoint_search_paths=trainer.checkpoint_search_paths(run_id),
438            load_checkpoint_setting=trainer.load_checkpoint,
439            mesh=mesh,
440            allow_partial=trainer.allow_partial_checkpoint,
441        )
442        if trainer.initialize_from is not None:
443            state = init_weights_only_from_checkpoint(
444                state,
445                trainer.initialize_from,
446                mesh=mesh,
447                allow_partial=trainer.allow_partial_checkpoint,
448                additional_weight_fields=("pending_qb_betas",),
449            )
450        dump_grug_state_sharding_run_artifact(
451            state,
452            log_dir=trainer.log_dir,
453            run_id=run_id,
454            path_override=config.trainer.sharding_dump_path,
455        )
456 
457        levanter.tracker.log_summary({"parameter_count": parameter_count(state.params)})
458 
459        flops_per_example, flops_summary = _compute_flops(model_config=config.model)
460        levanter.tracker.log_summary(flops_summary)
461 
462        eval_cfg = config.eval
463        evaluator = None
464        if eval_cfg is not None:
465            evaluator = build_tagged_evaluator(
466                data_config=config.data,
467                max_seq_len=config.model.max_seq_len,
468                mesh=mesh,
469                eval_cfg=eval_cfg,
470            )
471 
472        profiler_cfg = trainer.profiler
473        profiler_num_steps = profiler_cfg.resolve_num_profile_steps(num_train_steps=trainer.num_train_steps)
474        profiler_enabled = profiler_cfg.is_enabled and profiler_num_steps > 0
475 
476        log_every = max(1, config.trainer.log_every)
477        iterator = LoadingTimeTrackerIterator(train_loader.iter_from_step(int(state.step)))
478 
479        state_callbacks = StateCallbackRunner[GrugTrainState](
480            step_getter=lambda s: s.step,
481            model_getter=lambda s: s.params,
482            eval_model_getter=lambda s: s.ema_params if s.ema_params is not None else s.params,
483            opt_state_getter=lambda s: s.opt_state,
484        )
485        state_callbacks.add_hook(
486            callbacks.log_performance_stats(config.model.max_seq_len, batch_schedule, flops_per_example),
487            every=log_every,
488        )
489        state_callbacks.add_hook(callbacks.pbar_logger(total=trainer.num_train_steps), every=log_every)
490        state_callbacks.add_hook(callbacks.log_step_info(trainer.num_train_steps), every=log_every)
491        if profiler_enabled:
492            state_callbacks.add_hook(
493                profiler_cfg.build(
494                    str(trainer.log_dir / run_id / "profiler"),
495                    run_id=run_id,
496                    num_steps=profiler_num_steps,
497                ),
498                every=1,
499            )
500        state_callbacks.add_hook(_make_mixture_stage_callback(train_dataset, batch_schedule), every=1)
501        if evaluator is not None and eval_cfg is not None:
502            interval = eval_cfg.steps_per_eval
503            eval_ema = eval_cfg.eval_ema and config.trainer.ema_beta is not None
504            if interval is not None and interval > 0 and (eval_cfg.eval_current or eval_ema):
505                state_callbacks.add_hook(
506                    cb_tagged_evaluate(
507                        evaluator,
508                        prefix=eval_cfg.prefix,
509                        eval_current=eval_cfg.eval_current,
510                        eval_ema=eval_ema,
511                    ),
512                    every=interval,
513                )
514 
515        last_loss: float | jax.Array = 0.0
516        last_step_duration = 0.0
517 
518        # Main optimization loop.
519        try:
520            while int(state.step) < trainer.num_train_steps:
521                with jax.profiler.TraceAnnotation("load_batch"):
522                    batch = next(iterator)
523                step_start = time.perf_counter()
524                current_step = int(state.step)
525                # grad_watch runs only on its configured interval.
526                compute_watch = (
527                    watch_config.is_enabled and watch_config.interval > 0 and current_step % watch_config.interval == 0
528                )
529                state, metrics, watch_stats = train_step(state, batch, compute_watch=compute_watch)
530                step = int(state.step) - 1
531 
532                jax.block_until_ready(metrics["train/loss"])
533 
534                if jnp.isnan(metrics["train/loss"]):
535                    logger.error(f"NaN loss at step {int(state.step)}. Stopping training.")
536                    break
537                duration = time.perf_counter() - step_start
538                hook_start = time.perf_counter()
539                with jax.profiler.TraceAnnotation("callbacks"):
540                    state_callbacks.run(state, loss=metrics["train/loss"], step_duration=duration)
541                    last_loss = metrics["train/loss"]
542                    last_step_duration = duration
543                    levanter.tracker.log({"throughput/hook_time": time.perf_counter() - hook_start}, step=step)
544                    levanter.tracker.log({"throughput/loading_time": iterator.this_load_time}, step=step)
545                    router_metrics = {
546                        key: value
547                        for key, value in metrics.items()
548                        if (key.startswith("train/router/") or key.startswith("moe_bias/"))
549                        and key not in ("train/router/routing_counts_per_layer", "qb_beta_per_layer")
550                    }
551                    if router_metrics:
552                        levanter.tracker.log(router_metrics, step=step)
553                    if "train/cross_entropy_loss" in metrics:
554                        levanter.tracker.log(
555                            {"train/cross_entropy_loss": metrics["train/cross_entropy_loss"]},
556                            step=step,
557                        )
558 
559                    if watch_stats is not None:
560                        levanter.tracker.log(watch_stats, step=step)
561 
562                if checkpointer is not None:
563                    checkpointer.on_step(tree=state, step=int(state.step))
564        except BaseException:
565            logger.exception(
566                "Fatal error in grug training loop; skipping final callbacks/checkpoint to preserve root cause"
567            )
568            raise
569        else:
570            # Mirror classic trainer behavior: force callbacks on the last completed step.
571            state_callbacks.run(state, loss=last_loss, step_duration=last_step_duration, force=True)
572            if checkpointer is not None:
573                checkpointer.on_step(tree=state, step=int(state.step), force=True)
574                checkpointer.wait_until_finished()
575 
576    levanter.tracker.current_tracker().finish()
577 
578 
579def run_grug(config: GrugRunConfig) -> None:
580    """Dispatch grug training through Fray jobs."""
581    trainer = config.trainer.trainer
582    if trainer.id is None:
583        raise ValueError("trainer.id must be set before dispatching grug training.")
584 
585    dispatch_grug_training_run(
586        run_id=trainer.id,
587        config=config,
588        local_entrypoint=_run_grug_local,
589        resources=config.resources,
590        processes_per_task=config.processes_per_task,
591    )
